title.zh: 卷六 本紀第六: 世宗上
title.raw: 卷六 本紀第六: 世宗上 Volume 6 Annals 6: Shizong 1

sentences.zh: 世宗光天興運文德武功聖明仁孝皇帝，諱雍，本諱烏祿，太祖孫，睿宗子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Shizong, Guangtian Xingyun Wende Wugong Shengming Renxiao, taboo name Yong, originally taboo-named Wulu, was a grandson of Taizu and son of Ruizong.
translations.idiomatic: Shizong—the emperor styled Guangtian Xingyun Wende Wugong Shengming Renxiao, taboo name Yong, born Wulu—was Taizu’s grandson and Ruizong’s son.

sentences.zh: 母曰貞懿皇后李氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Zhenyi of the Li clan.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Zhenyi, née Li.

sentences.zh: 天輔七年癸卯歲，生於上京。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Tianfu, the year guimao, he was born at Shangjing.
translations.idiomatic: He was born at Shangjing in Tianfu year 7 (the guimao year).

sentences.zh: 體貌奇偉，美鬚髯，長過其腹，胸間有七子如北斗形。

translations.literal: His physique was extraordinarily grand; his beard and whiskers were fine, longer than his belly; on his chest were seven moles in the shape of the Big Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: He was huge in frame, with a splendid beard that hung below his belly, and seven moles on his chest arrayed like the Big Dipper.

sentences.zh: 性仁孝，沉靜明達。

translations.literal: By nature he was benevolent and filial, deep, calm, and clear-sighted.
translations.idiomatic: He was humane and filial by nature, reserved, and lucid in judgment.

sentences.zh: 善騎射，國人推為第一，每出獵，耆老皆隨而觀之。

translations.literal: Skilled at riding and archery, the people ranked him first; whenever he went out hunting, the elders all followed to watch.
translations.idiomatic: None could match him at horseback archery, and the nation proclaimed him first; on every hunt the greybeards trailed him to watch.

sentences.zh: 皇統間，以宗室子例授光祿大夫，封葛王，為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: During Huangtong, by the usual precedent for imperial clansmen he was made Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, enfeoffed Prince of Ge, and appointed Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the Huangtong era he was, as a clansman, made Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, enfeoffed Prince of Ge, and named minister of war.

sentences.zh: 天德初，判會寧牧。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tiande he was assigned to oversee Huining as magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: When Tiande opened he was put in charge as magistrate of Huining.

sentences.zh: 明年，判大宗正事，改中京留守，俄改燕京，未幾，為濟南尹。

translations.literal: The next year he oversaw the Great Clan directorate, was changed to regent of the Central Capital, soon after to Yanjing, and not long after became prefect of Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he headed the imperial clan office, was made regent of the Central Capital, then soon of Yanjing, and before long prefect of Jinan.

sentences.zh: 貞元初，為西京留守，三年，改東京，進封趙王。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhenyuan he was regent of the Western Capital; in year three he was moved to the Eastern Capital and advanced to Prince of Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Zhenyuan he held the Western Capital; in year 3 he was transferred to the Eastern Capital and raised to Prince of Zhao.

sentences.zh: 正隆二年，例降封鄭國公，進封衛國。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenglong, by precedent his rank was lowered and he was enfeoffed Duke of Zheng, then advanced to Duke of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenglong year 2 brought the usual demotion in rank—Duke of Zheng, then Duke of Wei.

sentences.zh: 三年，再任留守，徙封曹國。

translations.literal: In the third year he was again made regent and transferred to Duke of Cao.
translations.idiomatic: Year 3: another term as regent, and enfeoffment as Duke of Cao.

sentences.zh: 六年五月，居貞懿皇后喪。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the sixth year he was in mourning for Empress Zhenyi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year 6 he mourned Empress Zhenyi.

sentences.zh: 一日方寢，有紅光照室，及黃龍見寢室上。

translations.literal: One day as he lay asleep, red light filled the chamber, and a yellow dragon appeared above the bedchamber.
translations.idiomatic: Once, mid-sleep, red light flooded the room—and a yellow dragon showed above his bedchamber.

sentences.zh: 又嘗夜有大星流入留守第中。

translations.literal: Again, by night a great star flew into the regent’s residence.
translations.idiomatic: Another night a great star streaked into the regent’s quarters.

sentences.zh: 是歲，東梁水漲溢，暴至城下，水與城等，決女牆石罅中流入城，湍激如湧，城中人惶駭，上親登城，舉酒酹之，水退。

translations.literal: That year the East Liang River swelled and overflowed, rushing abruptly to the foot of the wall; the water stood level with the city, broke through the crenels and stone joints into the city, and ran like a torrent; the people inside were terrified; he personally mounted the wall, raised wine to libate the waters, and they withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: That year the East Liang swelled until it stood level with the wall, burst through the parapets into the streets, and roared through the town. In terror the people looked to him on the ramparts, cup in hand, libating the flood—and the water fell back.

sentences.zh: 海陵南伐，天下騷動。

translations.literal: Hailing’s southern campaign threw the empire into turmoil.
translations.idiomatic: Hailing marched south, and the realm shook.

sentences.zh: 是時，籍契丹部人丁壯為兵，部人不願行，以告使者，使者燥合畏海陵不以告，部人遂反。

translations.literal: At that time they registered stalwart Khitan tribesmen for service; the tribesmen refused to go and told the envoy; the envoy Zaohe feared Hailing and did not report it; the tribesmen then rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan tribes were mustered for the campaign; unwilling men appealed to the envoy Zaohe, who dared not tell Hailing—and they rose.

sentences.zh: 至是，咸平府謀克括裏陷韓州，據咸平，將犯東京。

translations.literal: By then the mouke Kuoli of Xianping Prefecture had taken Hanzhou, held Xianping, and was about to strike the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: By then Kuoli, mouke of Xianping, had seized Hanzhou, held Xianping, and was marching on the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 八月，起複東京留守。

translations.literal: In the eighth month he ended mourning early and again became regent of the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he left mourning to resume the Eastern Capital regency.

sentences.zh: 婆速路兵四百來會討括裏，複得城中子弟願為兵者數百人。

translations.literal: Four hundred troops from Bosu Road came to join in attacking Kuoli; he also recovered several hundred youths in the city willing to serve as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Four hundred soldiers from Bosu Road arrived to hunt Kuoli with him, and several hundred city youths volunteered for arms.

sentences.zh: 帝舅興中少尹李石以病免，家居遼陽。

translations.literal: The emperor’s uncle Li Shi, former vice intendant of Xingzhong, had retired on grounds of illness and lived at home in Liaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: His uncle Li Shi—once vice intendant of Xingzhong—had resigned for illness and kept to Liaoyang.

sentences.zh: 戊午，發東京，以石主留務。

translations.literal: On wuwu he set out from the Eastern Capital, appointing Shi to manage affairs left behind.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he marched from the Eastern Capital, leaving Shi in charge of the rear.

sentences.zh: 賊覘者聞鼙鼓聲震天，見旌旗蔽野，傅言國公兵十萬且至，賊眾至瀋州，遁去。

translations.literal: Rebel scouts heard drums shaking heaven and banners blotting the wild, and passed word that the State Duke’s army of a hundred thousand was almost upon them; the rebels reached Shenzhou and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Scouts heard thunderous drums and a sea of banners and spread the tale that a hundred thousand of the State Duke’s men were coming; at Shenzhou the rebels broke and ran.

sentences.zh: 會烏延查剌等敗賊兵，還至常安縣，海陵使婆速路總管完顏謀衍來討賊，以兵屬之。

translations.literal: It happened that Wuyan Zhacha and others had already defeated the rebels; returning to Chang’an County, Hailing sent Bosu Route commander-in-chief Wanyan Mouyan to pursue the rebels, and the troops were subordinated to him.
translations.idiomatic: Wuyan Zhacha had already routed them; as Mouyan came from Chang’an on Hailing’s orders to finish the campaign, the Eastern Capital force was placed under him.

sentences.zh: 九月，至東京。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he reached the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he returned to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 副留守高存福，其女在海陵後宮，海陵使存福伺起居。

translations.literal: The associate regent Gao Cunfu had a daughter in Hailing’s rear palace; Hailing had Cunfu spy on the regent’s daily comings and goings.
translations.idiomatic: Associate regent Gao Cunfu had a daughter in Hailing’s harem, and Hailing used him to watch the regent’s every move.

sentences.zh: 適以造兵器餘材造甲數十，存福宣言，留守何為造甲，密使人以白海陵，遂與推官李彥隆托為擊球，謀不利。

translations.literal: It happened that with leftover materials from making weapons he forged several dozen suits of armor; Cunfu proclaimed openly why the regent was making armor, secretly sent someone to inform Hailing, and with pushing-officer Li Yanlong used polo as a pretext to plot harm.
translations.idiomatic: He happened to smith a few dozen armors from weapon-work scraps; Cunfu asked aloud why the regent was arming men, secretly alerted Hailing, and with Li Yanlong plotted under cover of a polo match.

sentences.zh: 存福家人以其謀來告，平定知軍李蒲速越亦言其事。

translations.literal: Cunfu’s household, learning the plot, came to report it; the Pingding military overseer Li Pusuoyue also spoke of the affair.
translations.idiomatic: Cunfu’s people tipped him off; Li Pusuoyue, who knew the armies at Pingding, said the same.

sentences.zh: 海陵嘗聞上有疾，即使近習來觀動靜，至是，又使謀良虎圖淮北諸王，上知之，心常隱憂。

translations.literal: Hailing had heard that the regent was ill and repeatedly sent intimates to watch his movements; now he again sent Mou Lianghu to plot against the princes north of the Huai; the regent knew this and inwardly was ever anxious.
translations.idiomatic: Word of illness had sent Hailing’s spies before; now Mou Lianghu was to encircle the Huai princes—the regent knew, and dread gathered in him.

sentences.zh: 及討括裏還至清河，遇故吏六斤乘傳自南來，具言海陵殺其母，殺兄子檀奴、阿裏白及樞密使僕散忽土等，又曰：「且遣人來害宗室兄弟矣！

translations.literal: When he returned from campaigning against Kuoli to Qinghe, he met his old clerk Liujin traveling post-haste from the south, who fully reported that Hailing had killed his mother, killed his brother’s sons Tannu and Ari Bai and Privy Commissioner Pusan Hutu, and said: “He is also about to send men to kill the clansmen brothers!
translations.idiomatic: Marching back from Kuoli at Qinghe he met his old retainer Liujin, fresh from the south, with full report: Hailing had killed his mother; killed his brother’s sons Tannu and Ari Bai; killed Privy Commissioner Pusan Hutu; and said, 「They are coming for the clansmen next!

sentences.zh: 」上聞之，益懼。

translations.literal: ” When he heard it, he was still more afraid.
translations.idiomatic: 」 The news chilled him further.

sentences.zh: 及聞存福圖己，事且有跡，李石勸上早圖之。

translations.literal: When he heard also that Cunfu was plotting against him and the matter already had traces, Li Shi urged him to act early.
translations.idiomatic: Learning Cunfu’s plot was no longer rumor, Li Shi pressed him to strike first.

sentences.zh: 於是，以議備賊事，召官屬會清安寺，彥隆先到，存福累召始來，並於座上執之。

translations.literal: Thereupon, on the pretext of deliberating preparations against the rebels, he summoned officials to meet at Qing’an Temple; Yanlong arrived first, Cunfu was summoned repeatedly before he came, and both were seized in their seats.
translations.idiomatic: He called the staff to Qing’an Temple to plan against the rebels; Yanlong came first, Cunfu only after repeated summons—and both were taken where they sat.

sentences.zh: 是月，複有雲來自西，黃龍見雲中。

translations.literal: That month, again cloud came from the west, and a yellow dragon appeared in the cloud.
translations.idiomatic: That month cloud rolled in from the west, and a yellow dragon showed in the sky.

sentences.zh: 十月辛丑，南征萬戶完顏福壽、高忠建、盧萬家奴等自山東率所領兵二萬，完顏謀衍自常安率兵五千皆來附。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou in the tenth month, the southern-campaign wanhu Wanyan Fushou, Gao Zhongjian, Lu Wanjianu, and others from Shandong led their respective troops, twenty thousand men; Wanyan Mouyan from Chang’an led five thousand troops—all came to attach themselves.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the tenth month Fushou, Zhongjian, and Wanjianu led twenty thousand from Shandong; Mouyan brought five thousand from Chang’an—all cast in their lot with him.

sentences.zh: 謀衍即以臣禮上謁。

translations.literal: Mouyan at once paid court to him in the manner of a subject.
translations.idiomatic: Mouyan was first to bow as subject.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，諸軍入城，共擊殺存福等。

translations.literal: On yisi all the armies entered the city and together attacked and killed Cunfu and the rest.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the armies entered the city and cut down Cunfu and his faction.

sentences.zh: 是夜，諸軍被甲環衛皇城。

translations.literal: That night the armies donned armor and ringed the imperial city as guards.
translations.idiomatic: That night armored men ringed the royal city.

sentences.zh: 丙午，慶雲見，官屬諸軍勸進，固讓良久，於是親告天太祖廟，還禦宣政殿，即皇帝位。

translations.literal: On bingwu auspicious cloud appeared; officials and the armies urged him to ascend; he firmly declined for a long time; thereupon he personally announced to Heaven at Taizu’s temple, returned to preside in the Hall of Xuanzheng, and assumed the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu lucky clouds showed; court and camp pressed him to rule; he refused until refusal itself became ceremony—then he told Heaven before Taizu’s shrine, took the Xuanzheng Hall, and became emperor.

sentences.zh: 以完顏謀衍為右副元帥，高忠建元帥左監軍，完顏福壽右監軍，盧萬家奴顯德軍節度使。

translations.literal: He made Wanyan Mouyan right deputy commander-in-chief, Gao Zhongjian left army marshal’s inspector, Wanyan Fushou right army marshal’s inspector, and Lu Wanjianu military commissioner of Xiande Army.
translations.idiomatic: Mouyan he made right deputy commander-in-chief; Zhongjian left inspector of the army; Fushou right inspector; Wanjianu commissioner of the Xiande Army.

sentences.zh: 丁未，大赦，改元大定。

translations.literal: On dingwei there was a general amnesty and the era was changed to Dading.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he pardoned the realm and proclaimed the era Dading.

sentences.zh: 下詔暴揚海陵罪惡數十事。

translations.literal: An edict was issued exposing several tens of Hailing’s crimes.
translations.idiomatic: An edict laid out scores of Hailing’s crimes for all to see.

sentences.zh: 己酉，饗將士，賜官賞各有差，仍給複三年。

translations.literal: On jiyou he feasted officers and soldiers, bestowing office and rewards each according to rank, and also granted three years’ exemption from corvée and taxes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he feasted the troops, rewarded them by rank, and remitted taxes and labor for three years.

sentences.zh: 會甯、胡裏改、速頻等路南伐諸軍，會尚書省，奏請以從軍來者補諸局司承應人及官吏闕員。

translations.literal: He convened the armies on the southern expedition from Huining, Huligai, Supin, and other routes with the Secretariat to memorialise that those who had come with the armies should fill vacancies among clerks and attendants in various bureaus and among officials.
translations.idiomatic: Armies of the southern march from Huining, Huligai, Supin, and elsewhere met the Secretariat, which asked to staff vacant posts with men who had followed the colors.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「舊人南征者即還，何以處之。

translations.literal: The emperor said: “Those old hands who marched south are about to return—how will you place them?
translations.idiomatic: He said, 「The veterans of the southern war are coming home—what becomes of them?

sentences.zh: 必不可闕者，量用新人可也。

translations.literal: Where posts absolutely cannot lack men, use new men only in measured number.
translations.idiomatic: Where a post must be filled, take a few new men—no more.

sentences.zh: 」辛亥，以利涉軍節度使獨吉義為參知政事。

translations.literal: ” On xinhai he made Dugu Yi, military commissioner of the Lishi Army, Participating Administrator of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: 」 On xinhai he named Dugu Yi, commissioner of the Lishi Army, participating administrator of state affairs.

sentences.zh: 中都留守、西北面行營都統完顏彀英將兵三萬駐歸化，以為左副元帥。

translations.literal: The Zhongdu regent and supreme commander of the northwest field army, Wanyan Guying, would lead thirty thousand troops stationed at Guihua as left deputy commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Guying, regent of Zhongdu and supreme commander on the northwest front, was to bring thirty thousand from Guihua as left deputy commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，出內府金銀器物贍軍，吏民出財物佐官用者甚眾。

translations.literal: On dingsi he distributed gold, silver, and vessels from the inner treasury to supply the army; officials and commoners who offered property to assist official expenses were very many.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he paid the troops from the palace vaults—and so many officials and folk poured out wealth to help the war chest that the lists could scarce hold them.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以前臨潢 尹晏為左丞相。

translations.literal: On renxu, former Linhuang intendant Yan was made left chief councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the former intendant of Linhuang, Yan, was appointed left chief councillor.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔諭南京太傅、尚書令張浩。

translations.literal: On guihai, an edict instructed Nanjing Grand Tutor and Minister Director Zhang Hao.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai an edict was sent to Zhang Hao, grand tutor at Nanjing and minister director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 甲子，興平軍節度使張玄素上謁。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Xingping military commissioner Zhang Xuansu presented himself in audience.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Zhang Xuansu, military commissioner of Xingping, came to pay his respects.

sentences.zh: 尚書省奏：「正隆軍興之余，進錢粟者宜量授以官。

translations.literal: The Secretariat memorialized: 「After the Zhenglong campaigns, those who offered money and grain should be granted office in proportion.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat memorialized: 「In the wake of the Zhenglong wars, men who advanced money and grain ought to receive office in due measure.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: 」The emperor assented.

sentences.zh: 詔遣移剌劄八招契丹諸部為亂者。

translations.literal: An edict dispatched Yila Zhaba to win over the Khitan tribes in revolt.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent Yila Zhaba to bring in the Khitan tribes that had risen in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 以前肇州防禦使神土懣為元帥右都監。

translations.literal: Former Zhaozhou defense commissioner Shen Tumen was made right commander deputy of the marshalate.
translations.idiomatic: The former defense commissioner of Zhaozhou, Shen Tumen, was made right commander deputy under the marshal.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳朔，以左丞相晏兼都元帥。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, new moon jisi: Left Chief Councillor Yan was also made commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, new moon on jisi: Left Chief Councillor Yan was also named commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以戶部尚書李石為參知政事。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Minister of Revenue Li Shi was made participating grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Li Shi, minister of revenue, was appointed participating grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔調民間馬充軍用，事畢還主，死者給價。

translations.literal: On jimao, an edict ordered commoners’ horses requisitioned for military use, returned to owners when done, compensation for those killed.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao an edict requisitioned private horses for the army, to be returned when the campaign ended and paid for if any died.

sentences.zh: 阿瑣、璋殺同知中都留守事沙離只，阿瑣自稱中都留守，璋自稱同知留守事，使石家奴等來上表賀。

translations.literal: Asuo and Zhang killed Associate Central Capital Regent Shalizhi; Asuo styled himself Central Capital regent and Zhang associate regent, and sent Shijianu and others to present a congratulatory memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Asuo and Zhang murdered Associate Central Capital Regent Shalizhi; Asuo declared himself regent of the Central Capital and Zhang his deputy, then sent Shijianu and others with a memorial of congratulation.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以如中都期日詔群臣。

translations.literal: On xinsi, he issued an edict to the ministers fixing the date for entering the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he issued an edict to the ministers setting the day he would enter the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔中都轉運使左淵曰：「凡宮殿張設毋得增置，無役一夫以擾百姓，但謹圍禁，嚴出入而己。

translations.literal: On renwu, he instructed Central Capital transport commissioner Zuo Yuan: 「Palace furnishings must not be increased; no single conscript may be levied to trouble the people—only tighten the precincts and strictly control entry and exit, that is all.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he told Zuo Yuan, transport commissioner of the Central Capital: 「Do not add to the palace furnishings; do not press a single laborer and vex the people—only keep the enclosures strict and watch who goes in and out, and no more.

sentences.zh: 」以尚書右司員外郎完顏兀古出為詔諭高麗使。

translations.literal: 」Associate director of the right bureau of the Secretariat Wanyan Wugu was made envoy to announce assurances to Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: 」Wanyan Wugu, associate director in the Secretariat’s right bureau, was made envoy to proclaim assurances to Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 癸未，遣權元帥左都監吾劄忽、右都監神土懣、廣甯尹僕散渾坦討契丹諸部。

translations.literal: On guiwai, Acting Marshal Left Commander Wuzha Hu, Right Commander Shen Tumen, and Guangning Intendant Pusan Huntan were sent to subdue the Khitan tribes.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwai Acting Marshal Left Commander Wuzha Hu, Right Commander Shen Tumen, and Guangning Intendant Pusan Huntan were dispatched against the Khitan tribes.

sentences.zh: 甲申，追尊皇考幽王為皇帝，諡簡肅，廟號睿宗，皇妣蒲察氏曰欽慈皇后，李氏曰貞懿皇后。

translations.literal: On jiashen, posthumously ennobled his father Prince You as emperor, style Jian-Su, temple name Ruizong; his birth mother of the Pucha clan as Empress Qinci; and Lady Li as Empress Zhenyui.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he posthumously raised his father, Prince You, to emperor under the style Simple and Solemn, temple name Ruizong; his birth mother of the Pucha clan was named Empress Qinci; and Lady Li, Empress Zhenyui.

sentences.zh: 群臣上尊號曰仁明聖孝皇帝。

translations.literal: The ministers offered the honorific Sagacious, Illumined, Sacredly Filial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers offered the style Sagacious, Illumined, Sacredly Filial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，追複東昏王帝號，諡武靈，廟號閔宗，詔中外。

translations.literal: On yiyou, restored the Donghun emperor’s title, style Wu-Ling, temple name Minzong, and proclaimed this within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he restored the Donghun emperor’s imperial title, posthumous name Wu-Ling, temple name Minzong, and proclaimed it throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 封子實魯剌為許王，胡土瓦為楚王。

translations.literal: Enfeoffed his sons Shilula as Prince of Xu and Hutuwa as Prince of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: He enfeoffed his sons Shilula as prince of Xu and Hutuwa as prince of Chu.

sentences.zh: 戊子，辭謁太祖廟及貞懿皇后園陵。

translations.literal: On wuzi, took leave at Taizu’s temple and Empress Zhenyui’s mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he took leave at Taizu’s temple and at Empress Zhenyui’s tomb park.

sentences.zh: 己丑，如中都。

translations.literal: On jichou, proceeded to the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he set out for the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 次小遼口。

translations.literal: Halted at Xiaoliao Mouth.
translations.idiomatic: He halted at Xiaoliao Mouth.

sentences.zh: 使中都留守宗憲先往。

translations.literal: Sent Central Capital regent Zongxian ahead.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Central Capital Regent Zongxian on ahead.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，次梁魚務。

translations.literal: On renchen, halted at Liangyuwu.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he halted at Liangyuwu.

sentences.zh: 樞密副使，北面行營都統白彥敬、南京留守北面行營副統紇石烈志寧以所統軍數來上。

translations.literal: Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Northern Route Campaign Commander-in-Chief Bai Yanjing and Nanjing regent and Northern Route Deputy Commander Hesili Zhining reported the strengths of their commands.
translations.idiomatic: Vice commissioner of military affairs and northern-route campaign commander-in-chief Bai Yanjing, together with Nanjing regent and northern-route deputy commander Hesili Zhining, submitted the strengths of their armies.

sentences.zh: 安武軍節度使爽來歸。

translations.literal: Anwu military commissioner Shuang came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Anwu Military Commissioner Shuang came over to his side.

sentences.zh: 乙未，完顏元宜等弑海陵於揚州。

translations.literal: On yiyi, Wanyan Yuanyi and others assassinated Hailing at Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyi Wanyan Yuanyi and his fellows assassinated Hailing at Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙申，次義州。

translations.literal: On bingshen, halted at Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen he halted at Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，宋人破陝州，防禦使折可直降，同知防禦使事李柔立死之。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Song forces took Shaanzhou; Defense Commissioner Zhe Kezhi surrendered, Associate Defense Commissioner Li Rouli died in defense.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Song troops took Shaanzhou; Defense Commissioner Zhe Kezhi surrendered, and Associate Defense Commissioner Li Rouli died defending the city.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙卯，次三河縣，左副元帥完顏彀英來朝。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, yimao: halted at Sanhe County; Left Vice Marshal Wanyan Guying came to audience.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, yimao: he halted at Sanhe County, and Left Vice Marshal Wanyan Guying came to audience.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，次通州，延安尹唐括德溫來朝。

translations.literal: On bingchen, halted at Tongzhou; Yan’an Intendant Tangguo Dewen came to audience.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he halted at Tongzhou, and Yan’an Intendant Tangguo Dewen came to audience.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，至中都。

translations.literal: On dingsi, arrived at the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he reached the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 戊午，謁太祖廟。

translations.literal: On wuwu, visited Taizu’s temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he visited Taizu’s temple.

sentences.zh: 巳未，禦貞元殿，受群臣朝。

translations.literal: On jiwei, held court in the Hall of Pure Origin and received the ministers’ obeisance.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei he took the throne in the Hall of Pure Origin and received the ministers’ obeisance.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以元帥左監軍高忠建等為報諭宋國使。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Marshal Left Inspector Gao Zhongjian and others were made envoys to announce assurances to Song.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Gao Zhongjian, left inspector of the marshalate, and others were made envoys to proclaim assurances to Song.

sentences.zh: 壬戍，詔軍士自東京扈從至京師者複三年。

translations.literal: On renxu, an edict granted soldiers who had escorted him from the Eastern Capital to the capital a three-year tax exemption.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu an edict exempted soldiers who had escorted him from the Eastern Capital to the capital from corvée for three years.

sentences.zh: 同知河間尹高昌福上書陳便宜，上覽之再三。

translations.literal: Associate Hejian intendant Gao Changfu memorialized practical reforms; the emperor read it again and again.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Changfu, associate intendant of Hejian, memorialized practical reforms; the emperor read it over and over.

sentences.zh: 詔內外大小職官陳便宜。

translations.literal: An edict called on officials great and small, within and without, to present practical reforms.
translations.idiomatic: An edict invited every official, high or low, inside and outside the capital, to set forth what would benefit the state.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔左副元帥完顏彀英規措南邊及陝西等路事。

translations.literal: On bingyin, an edict ordered Left Vice Marshal Wanyan Guying to arrange affairs on the southern frontier and the Shaanxi routes.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin an edict put Left Vice Marshal Wanyan Guying in charge of the southern frontier and the Shaanxi circuits.

sentences.zh: 二年正月戊辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Dading year 2, first month, new moon wuchen: eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Dading year 2, first month, new moon on wuchen: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 伐鼓用幣，上徹樂減膳，不視朝。

translations.literal: Drums were beaten and offerings used; the emperor stopped music, reduced his meals, and did not hold court.
translations.idiomatic: Drums were struck and silks offered; the emperor ceased music, took simpler meals, and did not hold court.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上謂宰相曰：「進賢退不肖，宰相之職也。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the emperor told the chief councillors: 「Promoting the worthy and removing the unfit is the chief councillor’s charge.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the emperor told his chief councillors: 「To advance the able and dismiss the worthless is your office.

sentences.zh: 有才能高於己者，或懼其分權，往往不肯引置同列，朕甚不取。

translations.literal: When someone of talent surpasses one’s own, fearing a division of power one often will not bring him to share the council bench—this I greatly disapprove.
translations.idiomatic: When a man outshines you, some fear he will share your power and refuse to seat him beside you on the council—a course I cannot abide.

sentences.zh: 卿等毋以此為心。

translations.literal: You must not let such thoughts guide you.
translations.idiomatic: Do not harbor that in your hearts.

sentences.zh: 」以前翰林學士承旨致仕翟永固為尚書左丞，濟南尹僕散忠義為右丞。

translations.literal: 」Retired Hanlin Academician Expositor Zhai Yonggu was made left vice director of the Secretariat; Jinan Intendant Pusan Zhongyi was made right vice director.
translations.idiomatic: 」Retired Hanlin expositor Zhai Yonggu became left vice director of the Secretariat, and Jinan Intendant Pusan Zhongyi right vice director.

sentences.zh: 都統斜哥、副統完顏布輝坐擅易置中都官吏，斜哥除名，布輝削兩階，罷之。

translations.literal: Commander Xiege and Deputy Commander Wanyan Buhui were punished for changing Central Capital officials on their own authority: Xiege was struck from the rolls and Buhui reduced two ranks and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Xiege and Deputy Commander Wanyan Buhui were punished for reshuffling Central Capital officials on their own: Xiege was struck from the rolls, Buhui demoted two ranks and removed.

sentences.zh: 辛未，禦太和殿，宴百官，宗戚命婦賜賚有差。

translations.literal: On xinwei, held court in the Hall of Great Harmony, feasted the hundred officials, and gave gifts in varying measure to kinsmen and titled wives.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he held court in the Hall of Great Harmony, feasted the hundred officials, and gave gifts in set measure to kinsmen and titled wives.

sentences.zh: 壬申，敕御史台檢察六部文移，稽而不行，行而失當，皆舉劾之。

translations.literal: On renshen, ordered the Censorate to inspect the six ministries’ documents: those delayed in execution or wrongly executed were all to be impeached.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he ordered the Censorate to review the six ministries’ paperwork—anything held up or done amiss was to be impeached.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，除迎賽神佛禁令。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, the prohibition on welcoming and sacrificial Buddhist images was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the ban on welcoming and offering to Buddhist images was removed.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，如大房山。

translations.literal: On yihai, proceeded to Great Fang Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he went to Great Fang Mountain.

sentences.zh: 丙子，獻享山陵，禮畢，欲獵而還，左丞相晏等諫曰：「邊事未甯，不宜遊幸。

translations.literal: On bingzi, after offering at the mountain tombs, when the rites were done he wished to hunt on the return; Left Grand Councillor Yan and others remonstrated, saying, "The border affairs are not yet settled; it is not fitting to go on excursion.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, after sacrifices at the imperial tombs, the rites finished and he meant to hunt on the way back. Left Grand Councillor Yan and others urged him: "The frontiers are still unsettled—you ought not go roaming."

sentences.zh: 」戊寅，還宮。

translations.literal: " On wuyin, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: " On wuyin he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 因諭晏等曰：「朕常慕古之帝王，虛心受諫。

translations.literal: Thereupon he instructed Yan and the others, saying, "I have long admired the ancient emperors and kings, who with open minds received remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: Then he told Yan and the rest: "I have always admired the ancient sovereigns who took counsel with an open mind.

sentences.zh: 卿等有言即言，毋緘默以自便。

translations.literal: If you have something to say, speak; do not keep silent to suit yourselves.
translations.idiomatic: When you have something to say, say it—do not hold your tongues for your own ease.

sentences.zh: 」辛巳，以兵部尚書可喜等謀反，伏誅，詔中外。

translations.literal: " On xinsi, because Minister of War Ke Xi and others had plotted rebellion, they were executed; an edict announced this inside and outside.
translations.idiomatic: " On xinsi Ke Xi, minister of war, and fellow conspirators were put to death, and an edict carried word through the realm.

sentences.zh: 是日，賜扈從猛安謀克甲士下至阿裏喜有差。

translations.literal: That day, the meng’an and mouke who had followed in attendance, from armored soldiers down to Alixi, were rewarded in differing degrees.
translations.idiomatic: That same day the meng’an and mouke in his train—from mailed troops down to Alixi—received gifts graded by rank.

sentences.zh: 遣左副點檢蒲察阿孛罕等賞賚河南將士。

translations.literal: Left Deputy Director of Palace Inspection Pucha A’bohan and others were sent to reward the officers and soldiers of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Pucha A’bohan, left deputy director of palace inspection, and others were dispatched to reward the Henan garrison.

sentences.zh: 以前勸農使移剌元宜為御史大夫。

translations.literal: Former Commissioner for Encouraging Agriculture Yelü Yuanyi was made Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Former agriculture commissioner Yelü Yuanyi was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 詔前工部尚書蘇保衡、太子少保高思廉振賜山東百姓粟帛，無妻者具姓名以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered former Minister of Works Su Baoheng and Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent Gao Silian to give grain and cloth in relief to the common people of Shandong; those without wives were to report their names.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent former Minister of Works Su Baoheng and the heir apparent’s junior tutor Gao Silian to distribute grain and cloth among the people of Shandong; men without wives were to have their names recorded and reported.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，行納粟補官法。

translations.literal: On gengyin, the law on buying office with grain was put into effect.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the statute allowing purchase of office with grain took effect.

sentences.zh: 遣右副元帥完顏謀衍率師討蕭窩斡。

translations.literal: Right Deputy Commander-in-Chief Wanyan Mouyan was dispatched to lead troops against Xiao Wohe.
translations.idiomatic: Right deputy commander-in-chief Wanyan Mouyan was sent at the head of an army to crush Xiao Wohe.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，上謂宰執曰：「朕即位未半年，可行之事甚多，近日全無敷奏。

translations.literal: On renchen, the emperor said to the chief ministers, "Since my enthronement has not yet reached half a year, there is much that can be done; recently there has been no memorializing at all.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he told the chief ministers: "I have been on the throne less than six months, and much remains to be done—yet lately you have brought me almost nothing.

sentences.zh: 朕深居九重，正賴卿等贊襄，各思所長以聞，朕豈有倦怠。

translations.literal: I dwell deep within the Ninefold Enclosure and rely on you to assist; each of you should think of his strengths and report them—how could I grow weary?"
translations.idiomatic: I sit deep in the palace and depend on your help. Each of you should speak from what he knows best. Do you think I tire of hearing it?"

sentences.zh: 」癸巳，太白晝見。

translations.literal: " On guisi, Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: " On guisi Venus appeared in broad daylight.

sentences.zh: 甲午，上謂宰執曰：「卿等當參民間利害，及時事之可否，以時敷奏。

translations.literal: On jiawu, the emperor said to the chief ministers, "You should weigh the benefit and harm to the people and whether current affairs are feasible or not, and memorialize in good time.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he told the chief ministers: "Weigh what helps or hurts the people; judge whether the times allow a policy or not—and bring me word in season.

sentences.zh: 不可公餘輒從自便，優遊而已。

translations.literal: You must not, once public business is done, simply suit yourselves and take your ease in idleness.
translations.idiomatic: Do not leave court and slip off to your own comfort, idle and at ease—that will not do.

sentences.zh: 」命河北、山東、陝西等路征南步軍並放還家。

translations.literal: " An order sent home the southern-campaign infantry of the Hebei, Shandong, Shaanxi, and other circuits.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered the southern-campaign infantry of Hebei, Shandong, Shaanxi, and other routes discharged to their homes.

sentences.zh: 咸平、濟州軍二萬入屯京師。

translations.literal: Twenty thousand troops of the Xianping and Jizhou armies entered camp at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty thousand men from the Xianping and Jizhou armies were billeted in the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以西南路招討使完顏思敬、兵部尚書阿鄰督北邊將士。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Southwest Route pacification commissioner Wanyan Sijing and Minister of War A’lin were ordered to oversee the northern-border troops.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Wanyan Sijing, southwest route pacification commissioner, and Minister of War A’lin were put in charge of the northern armies.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，前翰林待制大穎以言盜賊忤海陵，杖而除名，起為秘書丞。

translations.literal: Second month, on jihai, former Hanlin Attendant-in-Waiting Da Ying, who had spoken about bandits and offended Hailing, was beaten and struck from the rolls, then reappointed Secretary Director.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jihai, former Hanlin attendant Da Ying—flogged and dismissed under Hailing for warning about bandits—was raised again as secretary director.

sentences.zh: 補闕馬欽以諂事海陵得幸，除名。

translations.literal: Remonstrance Aide Ma Qin, who had won favor by flattering Hailing, was struck from the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrance aide Ma Qin, who had curried favor with Hailing through flattery, was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔前戶部尚書梁钅求、戶部郎中耶律道安撫山東百姓。

translations.literal: On gengzi, an edict ordered former Minister of Revenue Liang Qiu and Revenue Bureau director Yelü Dao to pacify the common people of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi an edict sent former Minister of Revenue Liang Qiu and bureau director Yelü Dao to reassure the people of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 招諭盜賊或避賊及避徭役在他所者，並令歸業，及時農種，無問罪名輕重，並與原免。

translations.literal: Bandits were summoned to submit; those who had fled bandits or corvée labor and were living elsewhere were all ordered to return to their livelihoods and sow in season; regardless of the gravity of their crimes, all were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels and refugees alike were called home: whoever had fled outlaws or draft labor was to return, plant on time, and resume his trade—and whatever the charge, he was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，太傳、尚書令張浩來見。

translations.literal: On renyin, Grand Tutor and Director of the Secretariat Zhang Hao came to audience.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Grand Tutor and Secretariat Director Zhang Hao presented himself at court.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以上初即位，遣遼陽主簿石抹移迭、東京曲院都監移剌葛補招契丹叛人，為白彥敬、紇石烈志寧所害，並贈鎮國上將軍，令其家各食五品俸，仍收錄其子。

translations.literal: On guimao, because at the beginning of the emperor’s reign Liaoyang registrar Shim Tan Yidie and Eastern Capital brewery intendant Yelü Gebui had been sent to win over Khitan rebels and were killed by Bai Yanjing and Hesheli Zhining, both were posthumously granted Defender-in-Chief of the State; their households were each to receive fifth-rank stipends, and their sons were enrolled in office.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, in memory of Liaoyang registrar Shim Tan Yidie and Eastern Capital brewery intendant Yelü Gebui—sent early in the reign to win Khitan rebels and slain by Bai Yanjing and Hesheli Zhining—the court posthumously made them Defender-in-Chief of the State, granted each family a fifth-rank stipend, and enrolled their sons.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以張浩為太師，尚書令如故，御史大夫移剌元宜為平章政事。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Zhang Hao was made Grand Preceptor, continuing as Director of the Secretariat as before; Censor-in-Chief Yelü Yuanyi was made Grand Councilor of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Zhang Hao became grand preceptor and kept the secretariat; Censor-in-Chief Yelü Yuanyi became a grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，定世襲猛安謀克遷授格。

translations.literal: On xinhai, regulations were fixed for promotion and transfer of hereditary meng’an and mouke.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the rules governing promotion of hereditary meng’an and mouke were codified.

sentences.zh: 壬子，乙太保、左領軍大都督奔睹為都元帥，太保如故。

translations.literal: On renzi, Yi the Grand Guardian, left commander-in-chief and chief marshal Bentu, was made Commander-in-Chief, continuing as Grand Guardian as before.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Bentu—Grand Guardian and left commander-in-chief—was named commander-in-chief while keeping his grand guardian title.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔降蕭玉、敬嗣暉、許霖等官，放歸田裏。

translations.literal: On guichou, an edict reduced the offices of Xiao Yu, Jing Sihui, Xu Lin, and others and sent them home to their fields.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou an edict demoted Xiao Yu, Jing Sihui, Xu Lin, and others and sent them back to their villages.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，複用進士為尚書省令史。

translations.literal: On jiayin, jinshi graduates were again used as secretariat clerks of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin jinshi degree-holders were again appointed clerks in the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，嵩州刺史石抹朮突刺等敗宋兵于壽安縣。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Song Prefecture prefect Shim Tan Zhu Tuci and others defeated Song troops at Shou’an County.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Song prefect Shim Tan Zhu Tuci and others beat Song forces at Shou’an County.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，鄭州防禦使蒲察世傑取陝州。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Zhengzhou defense commissioner Pucha Shijie took Shaan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Zhengzhou defense commissioner Pucha Shijie captured Shaan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔都元帥奔睹開府山東，經略邊事。

translations.literal: On jiazi, an edict ordered Commander-in-Chief Bentu to open a headquarters in Shandong and oversee border affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi an edict set Commander-in-Chief Bentu up in Shandong with a field headquarters to manage the frontier.

sentences.zh: 澤州刺史特末哥及其妻高福娘伏誅。

translations.literal: Ze Prefecture prefect Temuge and his wife Gao Funniang were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Ze Prefecture prefect Temuge and his wife Gao Funniang were put to death.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲戌，上謂宰臣曰：「比聞外議言，奏事甚難。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on jiaxu, the emperor said to the chief ministers, "Of late I have heard outside talk that it is very hard to memorialize.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on jiaxu, he told the ministers: "People outside say it is hard to get a hearing at court.

sentences.zh: 朕于可行者未嘗不從。

translations.literal: What I can do, I have never failed to follow.
translations.idiomatic: When I can act, I have never refused.

sentences.zh: 自今敷奏勿有所隱，朕固樂聞之。

translations.literal: From now on, in memorializing do not conceal anything; I am truly glad to hear it.
translations.idiomatic: From now on speak plainly in memorials—I am glad to hear you.

sentences.zh: 」戊子，上謂宰臣曰：「臣民上書者，多敕尚書省詳閱，而不即具奏，天下將謂朕徒受其言而不行也。

translations.literal: " On wuzi, the emperor said to the chief ministers, "When subjects and commoners submit memorials, I often order the Secretariat to review them in detail but do not have them reported at once; the realm will think I only receive their words and do not act.
translations.idiomatic: " On wuzi he told the ministers: "When the people send up memorials I often tell the Secretariat to vet them—and then nothing reaches me in time. The empire will think I listen but never act.

sentences.zh: 其亟條具以聞。

translations.literal: Have them set out the items quickly and report.
translations.idiomatic: Lay out each point and bring it to me without delay.

sentences.zh: 」庚寅，詔平章政事移剌元宜泰州路規措邊事。

translations.literal: " On gengyin, an edict ordered Grand Councilor Yelü Yuanyi to arrange border affairs on the Taizhou Route.
translations.idiomatic: " On gengyin Grand Councilor Yelü Yuanyi was ordered to manage frontier affairs on the Taizhou route.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，太和、厚德殿火。

translations.literal: On xinmao, the Taihe and Houde halls burned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the Taihe and Houde halls caught fire.

sentences.zh: 乙未，尚書兵部侍郎溫敦朮突剌等與窩斡戰，敗於勝州。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Minister of War Vice Director Wendun Zhu Tuci and others fought Wohe and were defeated at Sheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Vice Minister of War Wendun Zhu Tuci and others met Wohe in battle and were beaten at Sheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 三月癸亥，參知政事獨吉義罷。

translations.literal: Third month, on guihai, Participation Councillor Tuji Yi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guihai, Participation Councillor Tuji Yi was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 元帥左都監徒單合嘉敗宋將吳璘於德順州。

translations.literal: Left Army Supervisor Tushan Hejia defeated Song commander Wu Lin at De Shun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Left army supervisor Tushan Hejia routed Song’s Wu Lin at De Shun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，追削李通官職。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Li Tong’s offices were posthumously stripped.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Li Tong’s posthumous honors and offices were revoked.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，免南京正隆丁夫貸役錢。

translations.literal: On yisi, corvée-loan payments for Zhenglong laborers at the Southern Capital were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the Southern Capital remitted corvée-loan payments owed from the Zhenglong era.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以廉平誡諭中外官吏。

translations.literal: On xinhai, integrity and fairness were proclaimed in admonition to officials inside and outside.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai an edict enjoined honesty and fair dealing on officials throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔河南、陝西、山東，昨因捕賊，良民被虜為賊者，厘正之。

translations.literal: On guihai, an edict to Henan, Shaanxi, and Shandong: because of the recent hunt for bandits, innocent people had been seized and made bandits—this was to be set right.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai edicts went to Henan, Shaanxi, and Shandong: in the recent bandit round-up innocent people had been swept up as outlaws—their status was to be corrected.

sentences.zh: 四月己巳，右副元帥完顏謀衍等敗窩斡於長濼。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on jisi, Right Deputy Commander-in-Chief Wanyan Mouyan and others defeated Wohe at Changpo.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jisi, Wanyan Mouyan and others defeated Wohe at Changpo.

sentences.zh: 辛未，降廢帝亮為海陵郡王。

translations.literal: On xinwei, the deposed emperor Liang was demoted to Prince of Hailing Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the deposed emperor Liang was reduced to prince of Hailing commandery.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔減禦膳及宮中食物之半。

translations.literal: On yihai an edict halved the imperial table and palace provisions.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the court ordered imperial meals and palace rations cut by half.

sentences.zh: 夏國遣使來賀即位，及進方物，及賀萬春節。

translations.literal: Western Xia sent envoys to congratulate the enthronement, present local products, and observe the Ten-Thousand Springs festival.
translations.idiomatic: Western Xia sent envoys to congratulate the accession, offer tribute, and observe the Ten-Thousand Springs festival.

sentences.zh: 右副元帥完顏謀衍複敗窩斡於霿{箣松}河。

translations.literal: Right Vice Commander-in-Chief Wanyan Moyan again defeated Wo Wo on the Mengsong River.
translations.idiomatic: Right Vice Commander-in-Chief Wanyan Moyan again routed Wo Wo on the Mengsong River.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，宴夏使貞元殿。

translations.literal: On xinsi the Xia envoys were feasted in the Zhenyuan Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the court banqueted the Xia envoys in the Zhenyuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 故事，外國使三節人從皆坐廡下賜食。

translations.literal: By precedent, attendants of foreign envoys on the Three Festivals all sat in the side halls to receive food.
translations.idiomatic: By custom, followers of foreign embassies at the Three Festivals were fed in the side halls.

sentences.zh: 上察其食不精腆，曰：「何以服遠人之心。

translations.literal: The emperor noticed their fare was not fine or ample and said: “How can this win distant peoples’ hearts.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing that their food was coarse and scant, the emperor said, “How will this win the hearts of men from afar?

sentences.zh: 」掌食官皆杖六十。

translations.literal: ” All commissary officers were beaten sixty strokes.
translations.idiomatic: ” Every commissary officer was flogged sixty strokes.

sentences.zh: 癸未，夏使朝辭，乞互市，從之。

translations.literal: On guiwei the Xia envoy took leave of court and begged mutual markets; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei the Xia envoy took his leave and asked for border trade; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以左丞相晏為太尉。

translations.literal: On jichou Left Chief Councillor Yan was made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Left Chief Councillor Yan was appointed Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔征契丹部將士曰：「應契丹與大軍未戰而降者，不得殺傷，仍安撫之。

translations.literal: On renchen an edict to Khitan commanders and soldiers said: “Those Khitan who surrender to the main army without fighting must not be harmed but are to be reassured.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen an edict to the Khitan commanders and troops read: “Khitan who yield to the main army without fighting must not be killed or injured but are to be pacified.

sentences.zh: 後招誘來降者，除奴婢以已虜為定，其親屬使各還其家，仍官為贖之。」

translations.literal: For those later enticed to surrender, bondsmen are fixed by those already taken captive; their kin are to be sent home, and the state will ransom them.”
translations.idiomatic: For those won over later, household slaves already seized count as the standard; relatives are to be returned to their homes, and officials will redeem them.”

sentences.zh: 五月丁酉朔，以曷速館節度使白彥敬為御史大夫。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on dingyou, the new moon, Yisuguan military commissioner Bai Yanjing was made Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingyou, the new moon, Yisuguan commissioner Bai Yanjing became censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，遣元帥左監軍高忠建會北征將帥討契丹。

translations.literal: On wuxu Grand Marshal Left Supervisor Gao Zhongjian was sent to join the northern expedition commanders in suppressing the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Grand Marshal Left Supervisor Gao Zhongjian was dispatched to join the northern generals against the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以臨海軍節度使紇石烈志甯為元帥右監軍。

translations.literal: On jihai Linhaijun military commissioner Heshilie Zhining was made Right Supervisor of the Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Linhaijun commissioner Heshilie Zhining was named right supervisor of the grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 右副元帥完顏謀衍、元帥右監軍完顏福壽坐逗遛，召還京師，皆罷之。

translations.literal: Right Vice Commander-in-Chief Wanyan Moyan and Right Supervisor Wanyan Fushou, for dallying, were recalled to the capital and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Right Vice Commander-in-Chief Wanyan Moyan and Right Supervisor Wanyan Fushou were recalled to the capital and removed for sluggish campaigning.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，立楚王允迪為皇太子，詔中外。

translations.literal: On renyin Prince of Chu Yundi was installed as crown prince; an edict announced this inside and outside.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Prince of Chu Yundi was made crown prince, and an edict proclaimed it through the realm.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，押軍萬戶裴滿按剌、猛安移剌沙裏剌敗宋兵于華州。

translations.literal: On dingsi Pressing-Army wanhu Puman Anla and meng’an Yelü Shalila defeated Song forces at Hua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Pressing-Army wanhu Puman Anla and meng’an Yelü Shalila routed the Song at Hua Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 七月丁酉，複取原州。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on dingyou, Yuan Prefecture was retaken.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on dingyou, Yuan Prefecture was recovered.

sentences.zh: 丙午，宋主傅位於子甗。

translations.literal: On bingwu the Song ruler abdicated in favor of his son Shen.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the Song emperor abdicated to his son Shen.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔諭契丹。

translations.literal: On jiayin an edict addressed the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the court issued an edict to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，速頻軍士朮裏古等誣完顏謀衍子斜哥寄書其父謀反，並以其書上之。

translations.literal: On dingsi Sufen soldiers Shuligu and others falsely charged Wanyan Moyan’s son Xiege with sending his father a letter plotting rebellion, and presented the letter.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Sufen soldiers Shuligu and others accused Wanyan Moyan’s son Xiege of mailing his father a treasonous letter and submitted the text.

sentences.zh: 上覽書曰：「此誣也，止訊告者。

translations.literal: The emperor read it and said: “This is a false charge—question only the accusers.
translations.idiomatic: Reading it, the emperor said, “This is slander—interrogate only the informants.

sentences.zh: 」訊之，果誣也。

translations.literal: ” On inquiry it proved false.
translations.idiomatic: ” Under inquiry it was indeed false.

sentences.zh: 朮裏古伏誅。

translations.literal: Shuligu was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Shuligu was put to death.

sentences.zh: 庚申，太尉、尚書左丞相晏致仕。

translations.literal: On gengshen Grand Preceptor and Left Chief Councillor Yan retired.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Grand Preceptor and Left Chief Councillor Yan resigned office.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔發濟州會寧府軍在京師者，以五千人赴北京都統府。

translations.literal: On renxu an edict ordered troops of Jizhou and Huining Prefecture then in the capital—five thousand men—to proceed to the Northern Capital supreme command.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu an edict sent five thousand troops of Jizhou and Huining Prefecture then in the capital to the Northern Capital supreme command.

sentences.zh: 陝西都統璋敗宋將吳璘于張義堡。

translations.literal: Shaanxi supreme commander Zhang defeated Song general Wu Lin at Zhangyi Fort.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi supreme commander Zhang defeated Song general Wu Lin at Zhangyi Fort.

sentences.zh: 八月乙丑朔，奚抹白謀克徐列等降。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on yichou, the new moon, Xi meng’an Mobai and others of Xulie’s command surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yichou, the new moon, Xi meng’an Mobai, Xulie, and others surrendered.

sentences.zh: 左監軍高忠建破奚於栲栳山，及招降旁近奚六營，有不降者，攻破之。

translations.literal: Left Supervisor Gao Zhongjian broke the Xi at Kaoluo Mountain and won over six nearby Xi camps; where they would not yield, he stormed them.
translations.idiomatic: Left Supervisor Gao Zhongjian crushed the Xi at Kaoluo Mountain, won six neighboring Xi camps, and stormed those that refused submission.

sentences.zh: 盡殺其男子，以其婦女童孺分給諸軍。

translations.literal: All the men were killed; women and children were divided among the armies.
translations.idiomatic: Every man was killed; women and children were parcelled out to the troops.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，永興縣進嘉禾。

translations.literal: On dingmao Yongxing County presented auspicious grain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Yongxing County reported a crop of auspicious grain.

sentences.zh: 壬申，萬戶溫蒂罕阿魯帶與奚戰于古北口，敗焉，詔同判大宗正事完顏謀衍等禦之。

translations.literal: On renshen wanhu Wendihan Aludai fought the Xi at Gubeikou and was beaten; an edict ordered Associate Director of the Imperial Clan Court Wanyan Moyan and others to resist.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen wanhu Wendihan Aludai fought the Xi at Gubeikou and was defeated; the court ordered Associate Director of the Imperial Clan Court Wanyan Moyan and others to hold them.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，上謂宰臣曰：「百姓上書陳時政，其言猶有所補。

translations.literal: On guiyou the emperor told the chief ministers: “When commoners submit memorials on state affairs, their words still add something.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the emperor told his chief ministers, “When ordinary people memorialize on public affairs, their words still help.

sentences.zh: 卿等位居機要，略無獻替，可乎？

translations.literal: You hold the keys of policy yet scarcely offer correction—is that acceptable?
translations.idiomatic: You stand at the heart of government yet offer almost no remonstrance—can that be right?

sentences.zh: 夫聽斷獄訟，簿書期會，何人不能？

translations.literal: Who cannot hear cases, settle suits, and keep ledgers and deadlines?
translations.idiomatic: Who cannot judge lawsuits, tally accounts, and meet schedules?

sentences.zh: 唐、虞之聖，猶務兼覽博照，乃能成治。

translations.literal: Even the sages of Tang and Yu labored to take in much and illumine broadly before order was complete.
translations.idiomatic: Even the sage kings of Tang and Yu had to consult widely and see far before they could govern well.

sentences.zh: 正隆專任獨見，故取敗亡。

translations.literal: Zhenglong ruled by private opinion alone—hence ruin.
translations.idiomatic: Under Zhenglong one man’s private view ruled alone—and brought collapse.

sentences.zh: 朕早夜孜孜，冀聞讜論，卿等宜體朕意。

translations.literal: I toil early and late hoping to hear forthright counsel; you should weigh my intent.
translations.idiomatic: I labor from dawn to night hoping for honest counsel; you ministers should take my meaning to heart.

sentences.zh: 」詔：「百司官吏，凡上書言事或為有司所抑，許進表以聞，朕將親覽，以觀人材優劣。

translations.literal: ” An edict said: “Officials of every bureau who memorialize on affairs, or are blocked by their superiors, may submit memorials directly; I will read them myself to gauge men’s talent.
translations.idiomatic: ” An edict declared: “Officials at every yamen who wish to speak on policy, or are suppressed by their superiors, may file memorials directly; I will read them myself to judge talent.

sentences.zh: 」夏國遣使賀尊號。

translations.literal: ” Western Xia sent envoys to congratulate the honorific title.
translations.idiomatic: ” Western Xia sent envoys to congratulate the new honorific title.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，免齊國妃、韓王亨、樞密忽土、留守賾等家親屬在宮籍者。

translations.literal: On dingchou relatives of the Qi consort, Prince of Han Hen, Privy Commissioner Hutu, and Garrison Commander Ze who remained on palace registers were released.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou kinsmen of the Qi consort, Prince of Han Hen, Privy Commissioner Hutu, and Garrison Commander Ze still listed in palace registers were freed.

sentences.zh: 詔元帥右都監完顏思敬以所部軍與大軍會討窩斡。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Right Supervisor of the Grand Marshal Wanyan Sijing to join the main army with his command in suppressing Wo Wo.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Right Supervisor of the Grand Marshal Wanyan Sijing to march his troops with the main force against Wo Wo.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔左諫議大夫石琚、監察御史馮仲廉察河北東路。

translations.literal: On yiyou an edict sent Left Remonstrance Officer Shi Ju and Investigating Censor Feng Zhonglian to inspect Hebei East Route.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Left Remonstrance Officer Shi Ju and Investigating Censor Feng Zhonglian were sent to inspect Hebei East Route.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔御史台曰：「卿等所劾，惟諸局行移稽緩，及緩於赴局者耳，此細事也。

translations.literal: On dinghai an edict to the Censorate said: “What you impeach is only slow paperwork in the bureaus and tardiness in reporting to office—trifles.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the emperor told the Censorate, “Your impeachments chase only slow paperwork and late attendance at office—small matters.

sentences.zh: 自三公以下，官僚善惡邪正，當審察之。

translations.literal: From the Three Dukes down, the good and evil, the straight and crooked among officials—you should scrutinize that.
translations.idiomatic: From the Three Dukes downward you should examine which officials are worthy, which corrupt, which upright, which base.

sentences.zh: 若止理細務而略其大者，將治卿等罪矣！

translations.literal: If you handle petty business and neglect the great, I will punish you for it!
translations.idiomatic: If you chase minutiae and overlook the weighty, I will hold you to account!

sentences.zh: 」契丹老和尚降。

translations.literal: ” The Khitan Laoheshang surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: ” The Khitan leader Laoheshang surrendered.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，罷諸關徵稅。

translations.literal: On xinmao levies at all passes were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao transit duties at every pass were abolished.

sentences.zh: 九月甲午朔，完顏謀衍擒奚猛安合住。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on jiawu, the new moon, Wanyan Moyan captured the Xi meng’an Hezhu.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiawu, the new moon, Wanyan Moyan took the Xi meng’an Hezhu prisoner.

sentences.zh: 元帥左都監徒單合喜大敗宋將吳璘於德順州。

translations.literal: Left Supervisor of the Grand Marshal Tushan Hexi heavily defeated Song general Wu Lin at Deshun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Left Supervisor of the Grand Marshal Tushan Hexi routed Song general Wu Lin at Deshun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔尚書右丞紇石烈良弼以便宜招撫奚、契丹之叛者。

translations.literal: On yiwei, an edict ordered Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Hedashi Liangbi to recruit and pacify Xi and Khitan rebels with discretionary authority.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei an edict sent Right Vice Director Hedashi Liangbi to win over Xi and Khitan rebels as circumstances allowed.

sentences.zh: 庚子，元帥右都監完顏思敬獲契丹窩斡，余眾悉平。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Right Army Supervisor Wanyan Sijing captured the Khitan Wowo; the remaining bands were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Right Army Supervisor Wanyan Sijing took the Khitan rebel Wowo prisoner, and the rest of the insurgents were crushed.

sentences.zh: 以尚書左司員外郎完顏正臣為夏國生日使。

translations.literal: Wanyan Zhengchen, outer assistant in the Left Bureau of the Department of State Affairs, was made birthday envoy to Xia.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Zhengchen of the Department of State Affairs left bureau was appointed birthday envoy to Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，獵於近郊。

translations.literal: On renyin, hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the emperor hunted in the suburbs near the capital.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以移剌窩斡平，詔中外。

translations.literal: On yisi, because Yila Wowo was pacified, an edict announced this inside and outside.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, with Yila Wowo’s rebellion put down, an edict carried word through the realm.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，改葬睿宗皇帝。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Emperor Ruizong was reburied.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Emperor Ruizong was given a new burial.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以元帥右都監完顏思敬為右副元帥。

translations.literal: On renzi, Right Army Supervisor Wanyan Sijing was made Right Vice Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Right Army Supervisor Wanyan Sijing was appointed right vice commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔思敬經略南邊。

translations.literal: On wuwu, an edict ordered Sijing to oversee the southern frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu an edict put Sijing in charge of strategy on the southern front.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，奉遷睿宗皇帝梓宮于磐甯宮。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the coffin of Emperor Ruizong was ceremoniously moved to Panning Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Emperor Ruizong’s coffin was borne to Panning Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，元帥左監軍徒單合喜等敗宋兵於德順州。

translations.literal: On guihai, Left Army Supervisor Tushan Hexi and others defeated Song forces at Deshun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Left Army Supervisor Tushan Hexi and his command routed Song troops at Deshun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 河南統軍使宗尹複取汝州。

translations.literal: Henan Military Commissioner Zong Yin again took Ru Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Henan military commissioner Zong Yin recaptured Ru Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十月丁卯，以左副元帥完顏彀英為平章政事。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on dingmao, Left Vice Commander-in-Chief Wanyan Guyin was made Participation Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on dingmao, Left Vice Commander-in-Chief Wanyan Guyin became participation grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，如山陵，謁睿宗皇帝梓宮，哭盡哀。

translations.literal: On wuchen, went to the imperial tombs, paid respects to Emperor Ruizong’s coffin, and wept with full grief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen he went to the tombs, knelt before Emperor Ruizong’s coffin, and mourned until grief was spent.

sentences.zh: 平章政事、右副元帥僕散忠義等還自軍，上謁。

translations.literal: Participation Grand Councillor and Right Vice Commander-in-Chief Pusan Zhongyi and others returned from the army and had audience.
translations.idiomatic: Participation Grand Councillor and Right Vice Commander-in-Chief Pusan Zhongyi and others came back from campaign and were received in audience.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以僕散忠義為尚書右丞相、元帥左監軍紇石烈志甯為左副元帥。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Pusan Zhongyi was made Right Chief Councillor of the Department of State Affairs; Left Army Supervisor Hedashi Zhining was made Left Vice Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Pusan Zhongyi was named right chief councillor; Left Army Supervisor Hedashi Zhining was named left vice commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 戊子，葬睿宗皇帝于景陵，大赦。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Emperor Ruizong was buried at Jing Mausoleum; a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Emperor Ruizong was laid to rest at Jing Mausoleum and the court proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔左副元帥紇石烈志寧經略南邊。

translations.literal: On jichou, an edict ordered Left Vice Commander-in-Chief Hedashi Zhining to oversee the southern frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou an edict charged Left Vice Commander-in-Chief Hedashi Zhining with the southern front.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，華州防禦使蒲察世傑、丹州刺史赤盞胡速魯改敗宋兵於德順州。

translations.literal: On renchen, Hua Prefecture Defense Commissioner Pucha Shijie and Dan Prefecture Prefect Chisan Husulugai defeated Song forces at Deshun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Pucha Shijie, defense commissioner of Hua, and Chisan Husulugai, prefect of Dan, beat Song troops at Deshun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸巳朔，詔右丞相僕散忠義伐宋。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, new moon on guisi, an edict ordered Right Chief Councillor Pusan Zhongyi to attack Song.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the new moon of guisi, an edict sent Right Chief Councillor Pusan Zhongyi to war against Song.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，第職官，廉能、汙濫、不職各為三等而黜陟之。

translations.literal: On dingyou, officials were graded; the honest and capable, the corrupt and excessive, and the negligent were each placed in three ranks for promotion and demotion.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the court ranked its officers—worthy, venal, and slack each in three grades—and promoted or demoted them accordingly.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙酉，遣尚書刑部侍郎劉仲淵等廉察宣諭東京、北京等路。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on yiyou, Vice Director of the Ministry of Justice Liu Zhongyuan and others were sent to inspect and proclaim comfort in the Tokyo, Beijing, and other routes.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yiyou, Liu Zhongyuan of the Ministry of Justice and others were dispatched to inspect and reassure the Tokyo and Beijing circuits.

sentences.zh: 三年正月壬辰朔，高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Third year, first month, new moon on renchen, Goryeo and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, first month, on the new moon of renchen, Goryeo and Western Xia sent envoys with congratulations.

sentences.zh: 庚子，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Venus appeared in broad daylight.

sentences.zh: 壬子，遣客省使烏居仁賞勞河南軍士。

translations.literal: On renzi, Guest Bureau Commissioner Wuju Ren was sent to reward the Henan garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Guest Bureau Commissioner Wuju Ren was sent to reward the soldiers in Henan.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，複取德順州。

translations.literal: On guichou, Deshun Prefecture was again taken.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Deshun Prefecture was recovered.

sentences.zh: 二月甲子，詔太子少詹事楊伯雄等廉問山西路。

translations.literal: Second month, on jiazi, an edict sent the Heir Apparent’s Junior Household Manager Yang Boxiong and others to inspect Shanxi Route.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiazi, an edict sent the heir apparent’s junior household manager Yang Boxiong and others to inquire into Shanxi Route.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上謂宰相曰：「灣州饑民，流散逐食，甚可矜恤。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the emperor told the chief ministers, "Famine refugees in Wan Prefecture wander seeking food—deeply pitiable.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the emperor told the chief ministers: "The hungry of Wan Prefecture scatter on the roads looking for food. They deserve our pity.

sentences.zh: 移于山西，富民贍濟，仍于道路計口給食。

translations.literal: Relocate them to Shanxi; let the wealthy support them; still give food along the road counted by mouth.
translations.idiomatic: Move them into Shanxi and let the rich sustain them—but still ration food along the way, head by head.

sentences.zh: 」壬申，詔撫諭陝西。

translations.literal: " On renshen, an edict to comfort and proclaim Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: " On renshen an edict went out to reassure Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，太保、都元帥奔睹薨。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Grand Preceptor and Commander-in-Chief Bentu died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Grand Preceptor and commander-in-chief Bentu died.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，趙景元等以亂言伏誅。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Zhao Jingyuan and others were executed for seditious speech.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Zhao Jingyuan and others were put to death for treasonous talk.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，高麗、夏遣使來賀萬春節。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Goryeo and Xia sent envoys to congratulate the Ten-Thousand Springs festival.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Goryeo and Western Xia sent envoys for the Ten-Thousand Springs festival.

sentences.zh: 高麗遣使賀即位。

translations.literal: Goryeo sent envoys to congratulate the enthronement.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo also sent envoys to congratulate the accession.

sentences.zh: 東京僧法通以妖術亂眾，都統府討平之。

translations.literal: A Tokyo monk, Fatong, stirred the masses with sorcery; the metropolitan command suppressed him.
translations.idiomatic: At Tokyo the monk Fatong led a cult with false magic; the metropolitan command put the disturbance down.

sentences.zh: 三月丙申，中都以南八路蝗，詔尚書省遣官捕之。

translations.literal: Third month, on bingshen, locusts struck the eight circuits south of Zhongdu; an edict ordered the Department of State Affairs to send officials to catch them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingshen, locusts plagued the eight circuits south of Zhongdu, and the Department of State Affairs was told to send men to destroy them.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔戶部侍郎魏子平等九人，分詣諸路猛安謀克，勸農及廉問。

translations.literal: On renyin, an edict sent nine men including Ministry of Revenue Vice Director Wei Ziping to the various routes’ meng’an and mouke to encourage agriculture and conduct inspections.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin nine officials led by Wei Ziping of the Ministry of Revenue were sent to meng’an and mouke in every circuit to promote farming and audit local rule.

sentences.zh: 詔臨潢漢民遂食于會寧府濟、信等州。

translations.literal: An edict: Han people of Linhuang seeking food were to be fed in Huining prefecture and the prefectures Ji, Xin, and others.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Han refugees from Linhuang fed through Huining and the prefectures Ji, Xin, and the like.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔免去年租稅。

translations.literal: On gengxu, an edict remitted last year’s taxes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu last year’s land tax was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 四月辛酉朔，右副元帥完顏思敬罷。

translations.literal: Fourth month, new moon on xinyou, Right Vice Commander-in-Chief Wanyan Sijing was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on the new moon of xinyou, Right Vice Commander-in-Chief Wanyan Sijing left office.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，平章政事完顏彀英、御史大夫白彥敬罷。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Participation Grand Councillor Wanyan Guyin and Censor-in-Chief Bai Yanjing were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Participation Grand Councillor Wanyan Guyin and Censor-in-Chief Bai Yanjing were removed.

sentences.zh: 以參知政事李石為御史大夫。

translations.literal: Participation Councillor Li Shi was made Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Participation Councillor Li Shi was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔吏犯贓罪，雖會赦不敘。

translations.literal: On dingchou, an edict: officials guilty of graft, even if pardoned, were not to be reappointed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou an edict declared that officials convicted of corruption would not return to office even under amnesty.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以引進使韓綱為橫賜高麗使。

translations.literal: On jimao, Introduction Commissioner Han Gang was made transverse-bestowal envoy to Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Introduction Commissioner Han Gang was named envoy bearing transverse gifts to Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，賑山西路猛安謀克貧民，給六十日糧。

translations.literal: On yiyou, poor meng’an and mouke of Shanxi Route were given relief—sixty days’ grain.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou poor meng’an and mouke on Shanxi Route received relief grain for sixty days.

sentences.zh: 是月，取商、虢、環州，宋所侵一十六州至是皆複。

translations.literal: That month Shang, Guo, and Huan prefectures were taken; the sixteen prefectures Song had seized were all recovered by then.
translations.idiomatic: That month the court retook Shang, Guo, and Huan; the sixteen prefectures Song had occupied were back in Jin hands.

sentences.zh: 五月辛卯朔，右丞相僕散忠義朝京師。

translations.literal: Fifth month, new moon on xinmao, Right Chief Councillor Pusan Zhongyi attended court at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the new moon of xinmao, Right Chief Councillor Pusan Zhongyi came to audience in the capital.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以重五，幸廣樂園射柳，命皇太子、親王、百官皆射，勝者賜物有差。

translations.literal: On yiwei, for the Double Fifth, visited Guangleyuan for willow-shooting; ordered the crown prince, princes, and officials all to shoot; winners were given gifts in differing grades.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, for the Double Fifth festival, he went to Guangleyuan for willow-shooting and had the crown prince, princes, and officials take part; victors received graded prizes.

sentences.zh: 上複禦常武殿，賜宴擊球。

translations.literal: The emperor again presided at Changwu Hall and granted a banquet with cuju.
translations.idiomatic: He again held court in Changwu Hall and gave a feast with a cuju match.

sentences.zh: 自是歲以為常。

translations.literal: From then on this became the annual custom.
translations.idiomatic: After that the court kept the practice every year.

sentences.zh: 丙申，宋人攻破靈璧、虹縣。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Song forces took Lingbi and Hong counties.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Song troops captured Lingbi and Hong counties.

sentences.zh: 己亥，罷河南、山東、陝西統軍司，置都統、副統。

translations.literal: On jihai the regional commander offices of Henan, Shandong, and Shaanxi were abolished and commanders and deputy commanders were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the court abolished the Henan, Shandong, and Shaanxi regional commander offices and appointed commanders and deputies in their place.

sentences.zh: 以太子詹事完顏守道從皇太子，上召諭守道曰：「卿任執政，所責非輕，自今毋從行。

translations.literal: As Crown Prince Household Administrator Wanyan Shoudao was accompanying the crown prince, the emperor summoned Shoudao and instructed him, saying, "You hold office as a councillor; your responsibility is not light—from now on do not accompany him on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Shoudao, crown prince household administrator, was with the crown prince; the emperor summoned him and said, "You serve as a councillor—your charge is weighty. From now on do not go with him on campaign.

sentences.zh: 」辛丑，以右丞相僕散忠義兼都元帥。

translations.literal: " On xinchou Right Chancellor Pusan Zhongyi was also made commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: " On xinchou Right Chancellor Pusan Zhongyi was also named commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，僕散忠義還軍。

translations.literal: On guimao Pusan Zhongyi returned the army.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Pusan Zhongyi brought the army back.

sentences.zh: 河南路都統奚撻不也叛入于宋。

translations.literal: Henan Route commander Xi Tabuye defected to Song.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Tabuye, commander of Henan Route, defected to the Song.

sentences.zh: 丙午，宋人攻破宿州。

translations.literal: On bingwu Song forces took Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the Song stormed Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，更定出征軍逃亡法。

translations.literal: On xinhai the law on desertion by expeditionary troops was revised.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the statutes on desertion from expeditionary armies were revised.

sentences.zh: 尚書省請籍天德間被誅大臣諸奴隸及從窩斡亂者為軍，上以四方甫定，民意稍蘇，而複簽軍，非長策，不聽。

translations.literal: The Secretariat requested registering as soldiers the slaves of ministers executed in the Tiande period and those who had followed the Wo Wo rebellion; the emperor said that since the four quarters had just been pacified and the people’s hearts were beginning to revive, to levy troops again was not a good long-term plan, and did not assent.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat asked to enroll as troops the bondsmen of ministers executed in the Tiande years and men who had followed the Wo Wo rising; the emperor said the realm had only just been settled and popular feeling was beginning to ease—another levy was no lasting policy, and he refused.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔諭契丹餘黨蒲速越等，如能自新，並釋其罪。

translations.literal: On guichou an edict addressed the Khitan remnant Pusuyue and others, saying that if they could reform themselves, all crimes would be released.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou an edict told the Khitan holdouts Pusuyue and the rest that if they would reform, every offense would be pardoned.

sentences.zh: 若執蒲速越父子以來者，仍官賞之。

translations.literal: If anyone brought Pusuyue and his father and son as captives, they would still receive official reward.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever delivered Pusuyue and his father and son would still be rewarded with office.

sentences.zh: 左副元帥紇石烈志寧複取宿州，河南副統孛朮魯定方死於陣。

translations.literal: Left Deputy Commander-in-Chief Heshilie Zhining recovered Suzhou; Henan Deputy Commander Boluoluo Dingfang died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Left Deputy Commander-in-Chief Heshilie Zhining retook Suzhou; Henan deputy commander Boluoluo Dingfang fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以北京留守完顏思敬複為右副元帥。

translations.literal: On yimao Beijing regent Wanyan Sijing was again made right deputy commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Beijing regent Wanyan Sijing was again named right deputy commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 中都蝗。

translations.literal: Locusts at Zhongdu.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts struck the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 詔參知政事完顏守道按問大興府捕蝗官。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Participation Councillor Wanyan Shoudao to investigate and question the Daxing prefecture officials who caught locusts.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent Participation Councillor Wanyan Shoudao to examine and question Daxing prefecture officials charged with catching locusts.

sentences.zh: 六月庚申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on gengshen new moon, an eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengshen, the new moon, there was an eclipse.

sentences.zh: 以刑部尚書蘇保衡為參知政事。

translations.literal: Minister of Justice Su Baoheng was made participation councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Justice Su Baoheng became participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔曰：「正隆之末，濟州路逃回軍士為中都軍所邀殺者，官為收葬。

translations.literal: On bingzi an edict said: "At the end of Zhenglong, returned soldiers of Jizhou Route whom Zhongdu troops waylaid and killed—the state shall provide burial.
