translations.idiomatic: On bingzi an edict read: "At the close of Zhenglong, Jizhou Route soldiers returning from service whom Central Capital troops ambushed and killed—the state shall bury them.

sentences.zh: 」己卯，觀稼於近郊。

translations.literal: " On jimao he inspected the crops in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: " On jimao he viewed the harvest in the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 甲申，太師、尚書令張浩罷。

translations.literal: On jiashen Grand Preceptor and Director of the Secretariat Zhang Hao was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Grand Preceptor and Secretariat Director Zhang Hao left office.

sentences.zh: 以宿直將軍阿勒根和衍為橫賜夏國使。

translations.literal: Palace Guard general Aleigen Heyan was made envoy bearing supplementary gifts to Western Xia.
translations.idiomatic: Palace guard general Aleigen Heyan was sent as supplementary-gift envoy to Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 七月庚戌，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on gengxu, Venus was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on gengxu, Venus appeared by day.

sentences.zh: 以太子太師宗憲為平章政事。

translations.literal: Crown Prince Grand Tutor Zong Xian was made associate chief councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Crown Prince Grand Tutor Zong Xian became associate chief councillor.

sentences.zh: 以孔總為襲封衍聖公。

translations.literal: Kong Zong was invested as hereditary Duke Yansheng.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Zong received investiture as hereditary Duke Yansheng.

sentences.zh: 八月丙寅，太白經天。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on bingyin, Venus crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingyin, Venus crossed the heavens.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔曰：「祖宗時有勞效未曾遷賞者，五品以上奏聞，六品以下及無職事者尚書省約量升除。

translations.literal: On gengwu an edict said: "Those who had merit in the time of the ancestors but never received promotion—in fifth rank and above memorialize for report; sixth rank and below and those without office, the Secretariat is to gauge and advance them appropriately.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu an edict declared: "Men who served the founding emperors yet never won promotion—fifth rank and above are to be reported up; sixth rank and below and men without posts, the Secretariat shall weigh and raise as fit.

sentences.zh: 」甲戌，詔參知政事完顏守道招撫契丹餘黨。

translations.literal: " On jiaxu an edict ordered Participation Councillor Wanyan Shoudao to win over Khitan remnants.
translations.idiomatic: " On jiaxu an edict ordered Participation Councillor Wanyan Shoudao to win over Khitan holdouts.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔罷契丹猛安謀克，其戶分隸女直猛安謀克。

translations.literal: On wuyin an edict abolished Khitan meng'an and mouke; their households were distributed among Jurchen meng'an and mouke.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin an edict dissolved Khitan meng'an and mouke companies and assigned their households to Jurchen companies.

sentences.zh: 命諸官員年老者，許存馬一二匹，餘並括買入官。

translations.literal: Officials who were aged were permitted to keep one or two horses; the rest were all requisitioned and purchased for the state.
translations.idiomatic: Elderly officials might keep one or two horses; all others were requisitioned and bought in for the government.

sentences.zh: 敕殿前都點檢唐括德溫：「重九出獵，國朝舊俗。

translations.literal: He instructed Palace Front Inspector Tangguo Dewen: "The Double Ninth hunt is an old custom of our dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: He told Palace Front Inspector Tangguo Dewen, "The Double Ninth hunt is an old custom of our house.

sentences.zh: 今扈從軍二千，能無擾民？

translations.literal: Now the escort is two thousand men—can it fail to trouble the people?
translations.idiomatic: Today the escort numbers two thousand—how can it not harass the people?

sentences.zh: 可嚴為約束，仍以錢萬貫分賜之。

translations.literal: Strictly impose discipline, and moreover distribute ten thousand strings of cash among them.
translations.idiomatic: Keep them under strict discipline, and also divide ten thousand strings of cash among them.

sentences.zh: 」乙酉，如大房山。

translations.literal: " On yiyou he went to Dafang Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: " On yiyou he traveled to Dafang Mountain.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，薦享於睿陵。

translations.literal: On dinghai he offered at Ruiling.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he presented offerings at Ruiling.

sentences.zh: 戊子，還宮。

translations.literal: On wuzi he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 九月癸巳，以宿直將軍僕散習尼列為夏國生日使。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on guisi, Palace Guard general Pusan Xinilie was made Western Xia birthday envoy.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guisi, palace guard general Pusan Xinilie was sent as Western Xia birthday envoy.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，秋獵。

translations.literal: On dingyou autumn hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the autumn hunt was held.

sentences.zh: 以重九，拜天於北郊。

translations.literal: Because of the Double Ninth, he worshipped Heaven at the northern suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: For the Double Ninth he worshipped Heaven at the northern suburbs.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔翰林待制劉仲誨等廉問車駕所經州縣。

translations.literal: On bingwu an edict ordered Hanlin Academician-in-Waiting Liu Zhonghui and others to conduct integrity inquiries in the prefectures and counties the imperial procession passed through.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu an edict sent Hanlin awaiting appointment Liu Zhonghui and others to conduct integrity inquiries along the route of the imperial progress.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，還宮。

translations.literal: On yimao he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 十月甲子，大享於太廟。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on jiazi, grand sacrifice at the Great Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on jiazi, the court offered the great sacrifice in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以許王府長史移剌天佛留為高麗生日使。

translations.literal: On bingyin Xu Prince Household senior administrator Yila Tianfoliu was made Goryeo birthday envoy.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Xu Prince Household senior administrator Yila Tianfoliu was sent as Goryeo birthday envoy.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，冬獵。

translations.literal: On guiyou winter hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the winter hunt was held.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚寅，太白晝見，經天。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on gengyin, Venus was seen in daytime and crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengyin, Venus shone by day and crossed the heavens.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，還都。

translations.literal: On renchen he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔：「求仕官輒入權要之門，追一官，仍降除。

translations.literal: On wushen an edict said: "Officials seeking office who rashly enter powerful men's doors shall be stripped of one rank and further demoted.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen an edict declared: "Office-seekers who thrust themselves into powerful men's houses lose one rank and are demoted further.

sentences.zh: 以請求有所饋獻及受之者，具狀奏裁。

translations.literal: For those who sought favors with gifts given and those who received them, fully memorialize for the throne's decision.
translations.idiomatic: Where gifts were offered to obtain favor or accepted, report the facts in full for imperial judgment.

sentences.zh: 」庚戌，百官請上尊號，不允。

translations.literal: " On gengxu the hundred officials requested an honorific title; he did not consent.
translations.idiomatic: " On gengxu the hundred officials asked to bestow an honorific title; he refused.

sentences.zh: 詔：「中都、平州及饑荒地並經契丹剽掠，有質賣妻子者，官為收贖。

translations.literal: An edict said: "In Zhongdu, Pingzhou, and famine and wasteland districts that had also suffered Khitan plunder, where wives and children had been pawned, the state shall redeem them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict read: "In the Central Capital, Pingzhou, and famine-stricken or wasted lands that Khitan raids had also ravaged, where wives and children were pawned, the state shall redeem them.

sentences.zh: 」壬子，尚書左丞翟永固罷。

translations.literal: " On renzi Left Vice Director of the Secretariat Zhai Yonggu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: " On renzi Left Vice Director of the Secretariat Zhai Yonggu left office.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，罷貢金線段匹。

translations.literal: On guichou tribute of gold-thread silk rolls was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou tribute of gold-thread silk bolts was abolished.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以尚書右丞紇石烈良弼為左丞，吏部尚書石琚為參知政事。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Right Vice Director of the Secretariat Heshilie Liangbi was made left vice director; Minister of Personnel Shi Ju was made participation councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Right Vice Director Heshilie Liangbi became left vice director of the Secretariat, and Minister of Personnel Shi Ju became participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁丑，臘，獵於近郊。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on dingchou, la month, he hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingchou, the la hunt, he hunted near the capital.

sentences.zh: 以所獲薦山陵，自是歲以為常。

translations.literal: The catch was offered at the mountain tombs; from then on this was done yearly.
translations.idiomatic: The game was presented at the imperial tombs, and thereafter this became an annual rite.

sentences.zh: 詔流民未複業，增限招誘。

translations.literal: An edict said: refugees not yet returned to their livelihoods—extend the time limit for inducement to return.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that refugees who had not yet resumed farming be given a longer deadline to be enticed home.

sentences.zh: 己卯，參知政事蘇保衡至自軍，辛巳，以為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: On jimao, Participation Councillor Su Baoheng arrived from the army; on xinsi he was made Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Participation Councillor Su Baoheng returned from campaign; on xinsi he was named right vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 四年正月丁亥朔，高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Fourth year, first month, on dinghai, new-moon day, Goryeo and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, first month, on dinghai, the new moon, Goryeo and Xia sent envoys with congratulations.

sentences.zh: 戊子，罷路府州元日及萬春節貢獻。

translations.literal: On wuzi, tribute at New Year and the Ten-Thousand Springs festival from circuits, prefectures, and counties was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the court ended New Year and Ten-Thousand Springs tribute from every circuit, prefecture, and county.

sentences.zh: 上謂侍臣曰：「秦王宗翰有功于國，何乃無嗣？

translations.literal: The emperor said to the attending officials: "Prince of Qin Zonghan had merit to the state—why then has he no heir?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked his attendants, "Prince of Qin Zonghan served the realm with distinction—why has he left no descendants?"

sentences.zh: 」皆未知所對。

translations.literal: " None knew how to answer.
translations.idiomatic: " No one could reply.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「朕嘗聞宗翰在西京坑殺丐者千人，得非其報耶？

translations.literal: The emperor said: "I once heard that at the Western Capital Zonghan buried alive a thousand beggars in a pit—is this not his retribution?"
translations.idiomatic: He said, "I have heard that at the Western Capital Zonghan slaughtered a thousand beggars in a mass grave—might that be his retribution?"

sentences.zh: 」癸巳，百官複請上尊號，不允。

translations.literal: " On guisi, the hundred officials again requested the honorific title; he did not consent.
translations.idiomatic: " On guisi the hundred officials again asked that he take an honorific title; he refused.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，如安州春水。

translations.literal: On dingyou, he went to Anzhou for the spring hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he went to Anzhou for the spring hunt.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，至安州。

translations.literal: On renyin, he reached Anzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he arrived at Anzhou.

sentences.zh: 大雪。

translations.literal: Heavy snow fell.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy snow fell.

sentences.zh: 詔扈從人舍民家者，人日支錢一百與其主。

translations.literal: An edict said: for attendants lodging in commoners’ homes, one hundred cash per person per day was to be paid to the host.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that when members of the retinue stayed in private homes, the host was to receive a hundred cash per guest per day.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，元帥府言：「宋遣審議官胡昉致尚書右僕射書，來議和好。

translations.literal: On jiachen the marshal’s office reported: "Song sent deliberation officer Hu Fang with a letter to the Right Censor-in-Chief, coming to discuss peace."
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the marshal’s office reported that Song had sent deliberation officer Hu Fang with a letter for the right censor-in-chief to negotiate peace.

sentences.zh: 以其言失信，拘昉軍中，以書答之。

translations.literal: Because their words broke faith, Hu Fang was detained in the army camp and an answer was sent by letter.
translations.idiomatic: Holding that Song had broken faith, they detained Hu Fang in camp and replied in writing.

sentences.zh: 」及以書進，上覽之曰：「宋之失信，行人何罪？

translations.literal: When the letter was submitted, the emperor read it and said: "Song broke faith—what crime is the envoy’s?"
translations.idiomatic: When the letter reached him, the emperor read it and said, "Song broke faith—what fault is the envoy’s?"

sentences.zh: 當即遣還。

translations.literal: He should be sent back at once.
translations.idiomatic: He should be sent home at once.

sentences.zh: 邊事令元帥府從宜措畫。

translations.literal: Border affairs were to be handled as the marshal’s office saw fit.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier matters were left to the marshal’s office to manage as circumstances required.

sentences.zh: 」乙巳，尚書省奏：「徐州民曹圭討賊江志，而子弼亦在賊中，並殺之。

translations.literal: " On yisi the Secretariat reported: "Xuzhou man Cao Gui pursued the bandit Jiang Zhi, but his son Bi was also among the bandits—both were killed."
translations.idiomatic: " On yisi the Secretariat reported that Cao Gui of Xuzhou had hunted the bandit Jiang Zhi, but his son Bi was among the bandits as well, and he killed them both.

sentences.zh: 法當補二官，敘雜班。

translations.literal: By law he should receive two ranks and appointment in the miscellaneous roster.
translations.idiomatic: By statute he merited promotion two ranks and a post on the miscellaneous roster.

sentences.zh: 」上以所奏未當，進一官，正班用之。

translations.literal: The emperor said the report was not appropriate; he advanced one rank further and appointed him in the regular roster.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor held the recommendation inadequate, added one more rank, and gave him a post on the regular roster.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，獲頭鵝。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the head geese were taken.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the head geese were taken.

sentences.zh: 遣使薦山陵，自是歲以為常。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent to offer them at the mountain tombs; from then on this was done yearly.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to present them at the imperial tombs, and thereafter this became an annual rite.

sentences.zh: 二月丁巳，免安州今年賦役，及保塞縣禦城邊吳二村凡扈從人嘗止其家者，亦複一年。

translations.literal: Second month, on dingsi, Anzhou’s taxes and corvée for the year were remitted, and for Baosai county’s Yucheng border villages Wu One and Wu Two, where the retinue had lodged, one year was remitted as well.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dingsi, Anzhou’s taxes and corvée for the year were remitted, and the two Wu villages on the Yucheng border of Baosai county, where the retinue had stayed, were also exempted for a year.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，獵于高陽之北。

translations.literal: On xinyou, he hunted north of Gaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he hunted north of Gaoyang.

sentences.zh: 庚午，還都。

translations.literal: On gengwu, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以北京粟價踴貴，詔免今年課甲。

translations.literal: On gengchen, because grain prices at Beijing were soaring, an edict remitted this year’s kejia levy.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, with grain prices soaring at Beijing, an edict remitted the kejia levy for the year.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌朔，萬春節，高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Third month, on bingxu, new-moon day, Ten-Thousand Springs festival; Goryeo and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingxu, the new moon, the Ten-Thousand Springs festival; Goryeo and Xia sent envoys with congratulations.

sentences.zh: 詔免北京歲課段匹一年。

translations.literal: An edict remitted Beijing’s annual silk tribute for one year.
translations.idiomatic: An edict remitted Beijing’s annual silk tribute for one year.

sentences.zh: 庚子，京師地震。

translations.literal: On gengzi, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，百官複請上尊號，不允。

translations.literal: On renyin, the hundred officials again requested the honorific title; he did not consent.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the hundred officials again asked that he take an honorific title; he refused.

sentences.zh: 四月丁巳，平章政事完顏元宜罷。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on dingsi, Grand Councilor Wanyan Yuanyi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on dingsi, Grand Councilor Wanyan Yuanyi was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，出宮女二十一人。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, twenty-one palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu twenty-one palace women were released.

sentences.zh: 五月，旱。

translations.literal: Fifth month: drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month there was drought.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，敕有司審冤獄，禁宮中音樂，放球場役夫。

translations.literal: On guimao an edict ordered the authorities to review wrongful cases, banned music in the palace, and released ball-court laborers.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao an edict ordered officials to review unjust convictions, forbade music in the palace, and released men conscripted for the ball court.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔禮部尚書王競禱雨於北嶽。

translations.literal: On yisi, Minister of Rites Wang Jing was ordered to pray for rain at the Northern Peak.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Minister of Rites Wang Jing was sent to pray for rain at the Northern Peak.

sentences.zh: 己酉，命參知政事石琚等於北郊望祭禱雨。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Participation Councillor Shi Ju and others were ordered to perform distant sacrifice for rain at the northern suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Participation Councillor Shi Ju and others were ordered to offer distant sacrifice for rain at the northern suburbs.

sentences.zh: 壬子，雨。

translations.literal: On renzi, rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi it rained.

sentences.zh: 窩幹餘黨蒲速越伏誅。

translations.literal: Pusu Yue, a remnant of the Wohu rebellion, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Pusu Yue, a holdout of the Wohu rebellion, was put to death.

sentences.zh: 六月甲寅朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on jiayin, new-moon day, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiayin, the new moon, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，尚書左丞紇石烈良弼至自征南元帥府。

translations.literal: On renxu, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat Heshilie Liangbi arrived from the southern campaign marshal’s headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Left Vice Director Heshilie Liangbi returned from the southern campaign marshal’s headquarters.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以雨足，命有司祭謝嶽鎮海瀆於北郊。

translations.literal: On jiazi, because the rain was sufficient, the authorities were ordered to offer thanks at the northern suburbs to the peaks, rivers, and seas.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, with the rains ample, officials were ordered to give thanks at the northern suburbs to the sacred peaks, rivers, and seas.

sentences.zh: 己巳，幸東宮，視皇太子疾。

translations.literal: On jisi, he visited the Eastern Palace to see the crown prince’s illness.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he went to the Eastern Palace to visit the ailing crown prince.

sentences.zh: 庚午，初定祭五嶽四瀆禮。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the rites for sacrificing to the five peaks and four rivers were first fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the court first set the rites for sacrifice to the five sacred peaks and four great rivers.

sentences.zh: 辛未，觀稼於近郊。

translations.literal: On xinwei, he viewed the crops in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he inspected the crops near the capital.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔諭元帥府曰：「所請伐宋軍萬五千，今以騎三千，步四千赴之。

translations.literal: On gengchen an edict told the marshal’s office: "You requested fifteen thousand troops to attack Song; now three thousand cavalry and four thousand infantry are sent."
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen an edict told the marshal’s office, "You asked for fifteen thousand men against Song; three thousand horse and four thousand foot are now dispatched."

sentences.zh: 」詔陝西元帥府議入蜀利害以聞。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered the Shaanxi marshal’s office to deliberate the advantage and harm of entering Shu and report.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict ordered the Shaanxi marshal’s office to weigh the pros and cons of an advance into Shu and report.

sentences.zh: 七月壬辰，故衛王襄妃及其子和尚以妖妄伏誅。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on renchen, the late Prince of Wei Xiang’s consort and her son the monk were executed for sorcery and false doctrine.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on renchen, the late Prince of Wei Xiang’s consort and her son Heshang were put to death for sorcery and imposture.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以尚書左丞紇石烈良弼為平章政事。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat Heishilie Liangbi was made participation councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Left Vice Director Heishilie Liangbi became participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，大風雷雨，拔木。

translations.literal: On xinchou, a great wind and thunderstorm uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou a violent thunderstorm uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 八月甲寅朔，詔征南元帥府曰：「前所請收復舊疆，乞候秋涼進發，今已秋涼，複俟何時？

translations.literal: Eighth month, on jiayin, the new moon, an edict to the Southern Campaign Marshal’s Headquarters said: “Earlier you asked to recover the old territory and begged to wait for cool autumn before advancing—autumn is cool now; how long will you wait?
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiayin, the new moon, an edict to the southern campaign marshal’s headquarters read: “You asked to recover the old borders and pleaded to wait for cool autumn—autumn is here; how much longer will you wait?

sentences.zh: 」戊午，以參知政事完顏守道為尚書左丞，大興尹唐括安禮為參知政事。

translations.literal: ” On wuwu, participation councillor Wanyan Shoudao was made left vice director of the Secretariat, and Daxing intendant Tangguo Anli was made participation councillor.
translations.idiomatic: ” On wuwu participation councillor Wanyan Shoudao became left vice director of the Secretariat and Daxing intendant Tangguo Anli participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 壬申，上謂宰臣曰：「卿每奏皆常事，凡治國安民及朝政不便於民者，未嘗及也。

translations.literal: On renshen, the emperor told the chief ministers: “In your memorials you speak only of routine matters; you never touch on governing the state and settling the people, or on court policies that harm the people.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the emperor told his chief ministers: “Your memorials are all routine—you never speak of governing the realm, easing the people, or policies that hurt them.

sentences.zh: 如此，則宰相之任誰不能之？

translations.literal: If so, who cannot fill a chief councillor’s post?”
translations.idiomatic: In that case, who could not be chief councillor?”

sentences.zh: 」己卯，如大房山。

translations.literal: On jimao, he went to Great Fang Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he went to Great Fang Mountain.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，致祭于山陵。

translations.literal: On xinsi, he performed sacrifices at the mountain tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he offered sacrifice at the mountain tombs.

sentences.zh: 九月癸未朔，還都。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on guimao, the new moon, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guimao, the new moon, he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，上謂宰臣曰：「形勢之家，親識訴訟，請屬道達，官吏往往屈法徇情，宜一切禁止。

translations.literal: On yiyou, the emperor told the chief ministers: “In powerful families, relatives and familiars bring lawsuits and ask favors to have cases forwarded—officials often bend the law to oblige them; all this must be forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the emperor told the chief ministers: “Powerful families use kin and friends to press lawsuits and ask that cases be passed along—officials often twist the law to please them; forbid it entirely.

sentences.zh: 」己丑，上謂宰臣曰：「北京、懿州、臨潢等路嘗經契丹寇掠，平、薊二州近複蝗旱，百姓艱食，父母兄弟不能相保，多冒鬻為奴，朕甚閔之。

translations.literal: On jichou, the emperor told the chief ministers: “The roads through Beijing, Yizhou, and Linhuang were once ravaged by Khitan raids; Ping and Ji prefectures have lately also suffered locusts and drought. The people lack food; parents, brothers, and sisters cannot support one another, and many rashly sell themselves as slaves. I am deeply moved.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he told the chief ministers: “Beijing, Yizhou, and Linhuang were once plundered by Khitan; Ping and Ji have lately suffered locusts and drought as well. Families cannot feed one another and many rashly sell themselves into slavery—I am deeply grieved.

sentences.zh: 可速遣使閱實其數，出內庫物贖之。

translations.literal: Dispatch envoys at once to verify their numbers and redeem them with goods from the inner treasury.”
translations.idiomatic: Send envoys at once to verify the numbers and redeem them from the inner treasury.”

sentences.zh: 」乙未，幸鷹房，主者以鷹隼置內省堂上，上怒曰：「此宰相聽事，豈置鷹隼處耶？

translations.literal: On yiwei, he visited the hawk yard; the keeper had placed hawks on the Secretariat hall table, and the emperor angrily said: “This is where the chief councillors hear cases—how can it be a place for hawks!”
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei he visited the hawk yard; the keeper had set hawks on the Secretariat council hall, and the emperor said in anger: “This is where chief councillors sit in session—what place is this for hawks!”

sentences.zh: 」痛責其人，俾置他所。

translations.literal: He sharply rebuked the man and had them moved elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: He rebuked the man severely and had the birds moved elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以宿直將軍烏裏雅為夏國生日使。

translations.literal: On jihai, Night-Duty General Wuliya was made birthday envoy to Western Xia.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Night-Duty General Wuliya was sent as birthday envoy to Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以太子少詹事烏古論三合為高麗生日使。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent Wugulun Sanhe was made birthday envoy to Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent Wugulun Sanhe was sent as birthday envoy to Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 十月癸丑朔，獵於密雲縣。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on guichou, the new moon, he hunted in Miyun County.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on guichou, the new moon, he hunted in Miyun County.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，還都。

translations.literal: On bingyin, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 己卯，命泰甯軍節度使張弘信等二十四人分路通檢諸路物力。

translations.literal: On jimao, he ordered Taining Army military commissioner Zhang Hongxin and twenty-three others to go by separate routes and inspect household property and resources in all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he ordered Taining Army commissioner Zhang Hongxin and twenty-three others to fan out by route and conduct property inspections in every circuit.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉，征南都統徒單克甯敗宋兵，取楚州。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on yiyou, Southern Campaign supreme commander Tushan Kening defeated Song troops and took Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yiyou, Southern Campaign supreme commander Tushan Kening routed the Song and took Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 己丑，封子永功為鄭王。

translations.literal: On jichou, his son Yonggong was enfeoffed as Prince of Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou his son Yonggong was made Prince of Zheng.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，冬獵。

translations.literal: On xinmao, winter hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the winter hunt.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔進師伐宋。

translations.literal: On yiwei, an edict ordered the armies to advance and attack Song.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei an edict ordered the armies south against Song.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，次河間府。

translations.literal: On wuxu, he halted at Hejian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu he halted at Hejian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，尚書省火。

translations.literal: On xinchou, the Secretariat caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the Secretariat burned.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，次清州。

translations.literal: On jiachen, he halted at Qing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he halted at Qing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬子朔，還都。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on renzi, the new moon, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on renzi, the new moon, he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁亥，尚書省奏都統高景山取商州。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on dinghai, the Secretariat reported that supreme commander Gao Jingshan had taken Shang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dinghai, the Secretariat reported that supreme commander Gao Jingshan had taken Shang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己丑，臘，獵於近郊。

translations.literal: On jichou, La offerings; hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, at the La festival, he hunted near the capital.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，太白晝見，經天。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Venus appeared in daylight and crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Venus was seen in daylight and crossed the heavens.

sentences.zh: 是歲，大有年。

translations.literal: That year, the harvest was abundant.
translations.idiomatic: That year the harvest was abundant.

sentences.zh: 斷死罪十有七人。

translations.literal: Seventeen persons were sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: Seventeen persons were put to death.

sentences.zh: 五年正月辛亥朔，高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Fifth year, first month, on xinhai, the new moon, Goryeo and Western Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on xinhai, the first month’s new moon, Goryeo and Western Xia sent New Year envoys.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔泰州、臨潢接境設邊堡七十，駐兵萬三千。

translations.literal: On yimao, an edict ordered seventy border forts set along the Taizhou and Linhuang frontier, garrisoned by thirteen thousand troops.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao an edict ordered seventy border forts along the Taizhou–Linhuang frontier, manned by thirteen thousand troops.

sentences.zh: 己未，宋通問使魏杞等以國書來。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Song liaison envoys Wei Qi and others came with the state letter.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Song liaison envoys Wei Qi and others arrived with the state letter.

sentences.zh: 書不稱「大」，稱「侄宋皇帝」，稱名「再拜奉書于叔大金皇帝」。

translations.literal: The letter did not use “Great”; it used “Nephew, Song Emperor,” and by personal name read, “Again bowing, I present this letter to Uncle, Great Jin Emperor.”
translations.idiomatic: The letter omitted “Great,” styled him “Nephew, Song Emperor,” and by personal name read: “Again bowing, I present this letter to Uncle, Great Jin Emperor.”

sentences.zh: 歲幣二十萬。

translations.literal: Annual tribute of two hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Annual tribute was set at two hundred thousand.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔中外。

translations.literal: On xinwei, an edict was issued to the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei an edict was proclaimed through the realm.

sentences.zh: 複命有司，旱、蝗、水溢之處，與免租賦。

translations.literal: Offices were again ordered that wherever drought, locusts, or floods had struck, rents and levies were to be remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Offices were again charged to remit rents and levies wherever drought, locusts, or floods had struck.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，命元帥府諸新舊軍以六萬人留戍，餘並放還。

translations.literal: On guiyou, the marshal’s headquarters was ordered to retain sixty thousand men from all new and old armies for garrison duty; the rest were all sent home.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the marshal’s headquarters was told to keep sixty thousand men from all armies, new and old, on garrison duty and send the rest home.

sentences.zh: 以宋國歲幣悉賞諸軍。

translations.literal: All of the Song annual tribute was used to reward the armies.
translations.idiomatic: All of the Song annual tribute was given as rewards to the troops.

sentences.zh: 二月壬午，以左副都點檢完顏仲等為宋報問使。

translations.literal: Second month, on renwu, Left Deputy Chief of the Palace Command Wanyan Zhong and others were made Song reply envoys.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renwu, Left Deputy Chief of the Palace Command Wanyan Zhong and others were sent as reply envoys to Song.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，罷納粟補官令。

translations.literal: On rentian, the edict allowing office through grain contributions was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On rentian the grain-for-office edict was abolished.

sentences.zh: 戊申，萬春節，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: On wushen, Ten-Thousand Springs festival; Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, the Ten-Thousand Springs festival, Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 三月壬申，群臣奉上尊號曰應天興祚仁德聖孝皇帝，詔中外。

translations.literal: Third month, on renshen, the ministers presented the honorific title “Emperor Who Responds to Heaven, Raises the Fortunate Line, Benevolent in Virtue and Sacred in Filial Piety,” and an edict announced this inside and outside.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renshen, the ministers offered the honorific Responds to Heaven, Raises the Fortunate Line, Benevolent in Virtue and Sacred in Filial Piety, and an edict proclaimed it through the realm.

sentences.zh: 四月癸卯，西京留守壽王京謀反，獄成，特免死，杖之，除名，嵐州安置。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on guimao, Western Capital regent Prince Shou Jing plotted rebellion; when the case was concluded he was specially spared death, flogged, stripped of rank, and exiled to Lan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on guimao, Western Capital regent Prince Shou Jing plotted rebellion; when the case was closed he was spared execution, flogged, stripped of rank, and exiled to Lan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，右副元帥完顏思敬罷。

translations.literal: On yisi, Right Deputy Marshal Wanyan Sijing was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Right Deputy Marshal Wanyan Sijing left office.

sentences.zh: 丁未，右丞相、都元帥僕散忠義還自軍。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Right Chancellor and Supreme Commander Pusan Zhongyi returned from the armies.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Right Chancellor and supreme commander Pusan Zhongyi returned from campaign.

sentences.zh: 五月壬子，左副元帥紇石烈志寧以召入見。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on renzi, Left Deputy Marshal Heishilie Zhining was summoned to audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renzi, Left Deputy Marshal Heishilie Zhining was summoned to audience.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以僕散忠義為尚書左丞相，紇石烈志甯為平章政事，還軍。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Pusan Zhongyi was made Left Chancellor of the Secretariat, Heishilie Zhining was made participation councillor, and both returned to the armies.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Pusan Zhongyi became left chancellor of the Secretariat, Heishilie Zhining participation councillor, and both returned to the armies.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以平章政事宗憲為尚書右丞相。

translations.literal: On yichou, Associate Chief Councillor Zong Xian was made Right Chancellor of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Associate Chief Councillor Zong Xian became right chancellor of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，罷山東路都統府，以其軍各隸總管府。

translations.literal: On guiyou, the Shandong Route superintendency was abolished, and its armies were each subordinated to the route military commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the Shandong Route superintendency was abolished and its troops were placed under the route commissioners.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰，芝產大安殿柱。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on jiachen, auspicious fungus grew on the pillars of the Da’an Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiachen, auspicious fungus appeared on the pillars of the Da’an Hall.

sentences.zh: 丙午，京師地震，雨毛。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the capital was shaken by earthquake, and fibrous rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the capital quaked and a rain of fine filaments fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 七月戊申朔，京師地複震。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on wushen, new-moon day, the capital shook again.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on wushen, the new moon, the capital trembled again.

sentences.zh: 罷陝西都統府，複置統軍司京兆，徙陝西元帥府河中。

translations.literal: The Shaanxi Route superintendency was abolished, the army command at Jingzhao was restored, and the Shaanxi marshal’s headquarters was moved to Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: The Shaanxi Route superintendency was abolished, the Jingzhao army command was restored, and the Shaanxi marshal’s headquarters was shifted to Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 八月己卯，前宿州防禦使烏林答剌撒以與宋李世輔交通，伏誅。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on jimao, former Suzhou defense commissioner Wulindá Lasà was executed for having dealings with Song’s Li Shifu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jimao, former Suzhou defense commissioner Wulindá Lasà was put to death for collusion with the Song general Li Shifu.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，宋、夏遣使賀尊號。

translations.literal: On guisi, Song and Xia sent envoys to congratulate on the honorific title.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Song and Western Xia sent envoys congratulating him on his honorific title.

sentences.zh: 九月丁未朔，以吏部尚書高衎等為賀宋生日使。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on dingwei, new-moon day, Minister of Personnel Gao Kan and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingwei, the new moon, Minister of Personnel Gao Kan and others were sent as envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday.

sentences.zh: 戊申，秋獵。

translations.literal: On wushen, autumn hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, the autumn hunt.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以宿直將軍朮虎蒲查為夏國生日使。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Night-Duty General Tihu Pucha was made Western Xia birthday envoy.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Night-Duty General Tihu Pucha was sent as birthday envoy to Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，還都。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 十月丁丑朔，地震。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on dingchou, new-moon day, earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on dingchou, the new moon, an earthquake struck.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以大宗正丞璋為高麗生日使。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Assistant Director of the Imperial Clan Bureau Zhang was made Goryeo birthday envoy.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Assistant Director of the Imperial Clan Bureau Zhang was sent as birthday envoy to Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 乙未，冬獵。

translations.literal: On yiwei, winter hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, the winter hunt.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，還都。

translations.literal: On xinchou, returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙午朔，上謂宰臣曰：「朕在位日淺，未能遍識臣下賢否？

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on bingwu, new-moon day, the emperor told the chief ministers: “My reign is still short, and I cannot know the worth of every official below me—
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingwu, the new moon, the emperor told his chief ministers: “I have not reigned long and cannot know every official’s merit—

sentences.zh: 全賴卿等盡公舉薦。

translations.literal: I rely wholly on you to recommend men with impartial fairness.
translations.idiomatic: I depend entirely on you to recommend men fairly and without favor.

sentences.zh: 今六品以下殊乏人材，何以副朕求賢之意。

translations.literal: Yet below the sixth rank talent is scarce—how can this meet my desire to seek the worthy?
translations.idiomatic: Yet talent below the sixth rank is desperately thin—how can that satisfy my wish to find the worthy?

sentences.zh: 」癸丑，幸東宮。

translations.literal: ” On guichou, he visited the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: ” On guichou he visited the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以右副都點檢烏古論粘沒曷為賀宋正旦使。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Right Deputy Director of Palace Attendants Wugulun Nemorhe was made envoy to congratulate Song on New Year’s Day.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Right Deputy Director of Palace Attendants Wugulun Nemorhe was sent as envoy to congratulate Song on New Year’s Day.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，立諸路通檢地土等稅法。

translations.literal: On guihai, the universal land-inspection tax law for all routes was enacted.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai a uniform land-inspection tax statute was established for every route.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，大霧。

translations.literal: On guiyou, heavy fog.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou a heavy fog settled.

sentences.zh: 晝晦。

translations.literal: The day turned dim.
translations.idiomatic: Daylight was dark as dusk.

sentences.zh: 十二月己丑，獵於近郊。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on jichou, hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jichou, he hunted in the suburbs near the capital.

sentences.zh: 高麗遣使賀尊號。

translations.literal: Goryeo sent envoys to congratulate on the honorific title.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo sent envoys congratulating him on his honorific title.

sentences.zh: 六年正月丙午朔，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Year six, first month, on bingwu, new-moon day, Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys with congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, first month, on bingwu, the new moon, Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys with congratulations.

sentences.zh: 庚午，敕有司：「宮中張設毋以塗金為飾。」

translations.literal: On gengwu, an edict to the responsible offices: “Palace furnishings must not use gilding as ornament.”
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu an edict to the responsible offices read: “Palace decorations must not be gilded.”

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅，上如西京。

translations.literal: Third month, on jiayin, the emperor went to the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiayin, the emperor went to the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 庚申，次歸化州，西京留守唐括德溫上謁。

translations.literal: On gengshen, he halted at Guihua Prefecture; Western Capital regent Tangguo Dewen came to audience.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he halted at Guihua Prefecture, where Western Capital regent Tangguo Dewen came to audience.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，至西京。

translations.literal: On wuchen, he reached the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen he reached the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 庚午，朝謁太祖廟。

translations.literal: On gengwu, he paid court at Taizu’s temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he paid court at Taizu’s temple.

sentences.zh: 壬申，擊球，百姓縱觀。

translations.literal: On renshen, he played cuju while the people looked on freely.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he played cuju while the common people watched at will.

sentences.zh: 四月甲戌朔，詔月朔禁屠宰。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on jiaxu, new-moon day, an edict forbade slaughter on the new and full moons.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jiaxu, the new moon, an edict forbade slaughter on new- and full-moon days.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以尚書右司郎中移剌道為橫賜高麗使，宿直將軍斜卯摑剌為橫賜夏國使。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Right Bureau director Yelü Dao in the Secretariat was made transverse-bestowal envoy to Goryeo, and Night-Duty General Xiema Goula transverse-bestowal envoy to Western Xia.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Secretariat Right Bureau director Yelü Dao was named envoy bearing transverse gifts to Goryeo, and Night-Duty General Xiema Goula envoy bearing transverse gifts to Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Venus appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Venus appeared in broad daylight.

sentences.zh: 五月戊申，幸華嚴寺，觀故遼諸帝銅像，詔主僧謹視之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on wushen, he visited Huayan Temple, viewed the bronze images of the former Liao emperors, and ordered the chief monk to guard them carefully.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wushen, he visited Huayan Temple, viewed the bronze statues of the former Liao emperors, and ordered the abbot to keep careful watch over them.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔雲中大同縣及警巡院給複一年。

translations.literal: On renzi, an edict granted Datong County in Yunzhong and the police patrol offices a one-year remission.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi an edict granted Datong County in Yunzhong and the police patrol posts a one-year tax remission.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔將幸銀山，諸扈從軍士賜錢五萬貫，有敢損苗稼者，並償之。

translations.literal: On renxu, an edict announced he would visit Silver Mountain; all escort soldiers were granted fifty thousand strings of cash, and anyone who damaged crops would make restitution.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu an edict announced a visit to Silver Mountain, granted fifty thousand strings of cash to every soldier in the escort, and required full compensation for any crop damage.

sentences.zh: 六月辛巳，太白晝見，經天。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on xinsi, Venus appeared in daylight and crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinsi, Venus shone by day and crossed the heavens.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，發自西京。

translations.literal: On bingxu, he set out from the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he set out from the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 庚子，獵於銀山。

translations.literal: On gengzi, he hunted at Silver Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he hunted at Silver Mountain.

sentences.zh: 七月辛酉，次三叉口。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on xinyou, he halted at Sanchakou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on xinyou, he halted at Sanchakou.

sentences.zh: 八月辛未朔，次涼陘。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on xinwei, new-moon day, he halted at Liangxing Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinwei, the new moon, he halted at Liangxing Pass.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，獵於望雲之南山。

translations.literal: On gengchen, he hunted on the south slope of Wangyun Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he hunted on the southern face of Wangyun Mountain.

sentences.zh: 十月己卯，以尚書兵部侍郎移剌按答為高麗生日使。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on jimao, Vice Minister of War in the Secretariat Yelü Anda was made Goryeo birthday envoy.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on jimao, Secretariat Vice Minister of War Yelü Anda was sent as birthday envoy to Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 甲申，朝享於太廟。

translations.literal: On jiashen, he offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 詔免雄、莫等州今年租。

translations.literal: An edict remitted this year’s land tax for Xiong, Mo, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: An edict remitted this year’s land tax in Xiong, Mo, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，太白晝見，經天。

translations.literal: On renchen, Venus appeared in daylight and crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Venus shone by day and crossed the heavens.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，如安肅州。

translations.literal: On dingyou, he went to Ansu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he went to Ansu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 冬獵。

translations.literal: Winter hunt.
translations.idiomatic: He held the winter hunt.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙午，還都。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on bingwu, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingwu, he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以右副都點檢烏古論元忠為賀宋正旦使。

translations.literal: On guichou, Right Deputy Chief Inspector Uygurun Yuanzhong was made envoy to congratulate Song on the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Right Deputy Chief Inspector Uygurun Yuanzhong was sent as envoy to congratulate Song on the New Year.

sentences.zh: 上謂宰臣曰：「朝官當慎選其人，庶可激勵其餘，若不當，則啟覬覦之心。

translations.literal: The emperor told the chief ministers: “Court officials must be chosen with care, so that the rest may be stirred to effort; if the choice is wrong, it only opens the way to covetous ambition.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told his chief ministers: “Court appointments must be made with care, so others may be stirred to merit; bad choices only breed covetous ambition.

sentences.zh: 卿等必知人才優劣，舉實才用之。

translations.literal: You surely know who is capable and who is not—appoint men of real talent.”
translations.idiomatic: You know who is fit and who is not—put real talent in office.”

sentences.zh: 」庚申，太白晝見，經天。

translations.literal: ” On gengshen, the Great White star was seen in daylight and crossed the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: ” On gengshen Venus shone by day and crossed the heavens.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，參知政事石琚以母憂罷。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Participation Councillor Shi Ju left office on account of his mother’s mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Participation Councillor Shi Ju left office to mourn his mother.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，詔有司，每月朔望及上七日毋奏刑名。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on jiaxu, an edict ordered the authorities that on each month’s new and full moons and on the upper seven days they were not to submit criminal cases.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiaxu, an edict ordered that on each new and full moon and on the upper seven days of the month no criminal cases were to be submitted.

sentences.zh: 戊子，太白晝見，經天。

translations.literal: On wuzi, the Great White star was seen in daylight and crossed the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Venus shone by day and crossed the heavens.

sentences.zh: 甲午，泰州民合住謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On jiawu, the commoner He Zhu of Taizhou plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu He Zhu, a commoner of Taizhou, plotted rebellion and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以平章政事紇石烈良弼為尚書右丞相，紇石烈志甯為樞密使。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Chief Councillor Heishilie Liangbi was made Right Director of the Secretariat, and Heishilie Zhining was made privy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Chief Councillor Heishilie Liangbi became right director of the Secretariat, and Heishilie Zhining privy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 七年正月庚子朔，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Seventh year, first month, on gengzi, the new moon: Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, on gengzi, the first month’s new moon, Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent New Year envoys.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，石琚起複參知政事。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Shi Ju resumed office as participation councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Shi Ju returned from mourning and resumed as participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 壬子，上服袞冕，禦大安殿，受尊號冊寶禮。

translations.literal: On renzi, the emperor donned ceremonial robes and caps, took the throne in the Hall of Great Peace, and received the ceremony of the honorific title, registers, and seals.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the emperor wore full ceremonial dress, took the throne in the Hall of Great Peace, and received the honorific registers and seals.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，大赦，庚申，以元帥左監軍徒單合喜為樞密副使。

translations.literal: On guichou, a general amnesty; on gengshen, Left Army Supervisor Tushan Hexi was made vice privy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou a general amnesty was proclaimed; on gengshen Left Army Supervisor Tushan Hexi became vice privy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二月庚寅，尚書右丞蘇保衡薨。

translations.literal: Second month, on gengyin, Right Vice Director of the Secretariat Su Baoheng died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengyin, Right Vice Director of the Secretariat Su Baoheng died.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以參知政事石琚為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Participation Councillor Shi Ju was made Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Participation Councillor Shi Ju became right vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 三月己亥朔，萬春節，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Third month, on jihai, the new moon, Wan Spring Festival: Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jihai, the new moon, at the Wan Spring Festival Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 四月戊辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on wuchen, the new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on wuchen, the new moon, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以御史大夫李石為司徒，大夫如故。

translations.literal: On renchen, Censor-in-Chief Li Shi was made Minister over the Masses, his censorate title unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Censor-in-Chief Li Shi was made Minister over the Masses, retaining his post as censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 五月丙午，大興府獄空，詔賜錢三百貫為宴樂之用，以勞之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on bingwu, the prisons of Daxing prefecture stood empty; an edict granted three hundred strings of cash for a feast to reward the staff.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingwu, Daxing prefecture’s prisons stood empty; an edict granted three hundred strings of cash for a feast to reward the officials.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以北京留守耨碗溫敦兀帶為參知政事。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Beijing defender Nuwandun Wudai was made participation councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Beijing defender Nuwandun Wudai became participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 六月癸酉，命地衣用龍文者罷之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on guiyou, an edict ordered that floor mats bearing dragon designs be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guiyou, an edict abolished floor mats bearing dragon designs.

sentences.zh: 七月戊申，禁服用金線，其織賣者，皆抵罪。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on wushen, wearing gold thread was forbidden; those who wove or sold it were all punished.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on wushen, wearing gold thread was forbidden, and weavers and sellers were all punished.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，幸東宮。

translations.literal: On bingchen, he visited the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he visited the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 己未，幸東宮視皇太子疾。

translations.literal: On jiwei, he visited the Eastern Palace to see the crown prince’s illness.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei he visited the Eastern Palace to see the crown prince, who was ill.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁卯，觀稼於近郊。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on dingmao, he viewed the crops in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on dingmao, he inspected the crops in the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，許王永中進封越王，鄭王永功封隨王，永成封審王。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Prince Xu Yongzhong was advanced to Prince of Yue; Prince Zheng Yonggong was enfeoffed Prince of Sui; and Yongcheng was enfeoffed Prince of Shen.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Prince Xu Yongzhong was advanced to Prince of Yue, Prince Zheng Yonggong was made Prince of Sui, and Yongcheng was made Prince of Shen.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔遣秘書監移剌子敬經略北邊。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, an edict dispatched Secretariat Supervisor Yila Zijing to oversee the northern frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu an edict sent Secretariat Supervisor Yila Zijing to oversee the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，幸東宮。

translations.literal: On wuyin, he visited the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he visited the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 己卯，慶雲環日。

translations.literal: On jimao, auspicious clouds ringed the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao celebratory clouds ringed the sun.

sentences.zh: 壬午，觀稼於近郊。

translations.literal: On renwu, he viewed the crops in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he inspected the crops in the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 戊子，觀稼於北郊。

translations.literal: On wuzi, he viewed the crops in the northern suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he inspected the crops in the northern suburbs.

sentences.zh: 八月辛亥，慶雲環日。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on xinhai, auspicious clouds ringed the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinhai, celebratory clouds ringed the sun.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，尚書右丞相監修國史紇石烈良弼進《太宗實錄》，上立受之。

translations.literal: On guichou, Right Director of the Secretariat and overseer of the state history Heishilie Liangbi presented the Veritable Records of Taizong; the emperor stood to receive them.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Right Director of the Secretariat and state-history overseer Heishilie Liangbi presented the Veritable Records of Taizong; the emperor stood to receive them.

sentences.zh: 己未，如大房山。

translations.literal: On jiwei, he went to Great Fang Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei he went to Great Fang Mountain.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，致祭睿陵。

translations.literal: On renxu, he offered sacrifice at the Ruiling tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he offered sacrifice at the Ruiling tombs.

sentences.zh: 九月乙丑朔，還宮。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on yichou, the new moon, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yichou, the new moon, he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 己巳，右三部檢法官韓贊以捕蝗受賂，除名。

translations.literal: On jisi, Han Zan, inspecting official of the Three Departments, was stripped of rank for taking bribes while catching locusts.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Han Zan, inspecting official of the Three Departments, was dismissed for taking bribes while supervising locust control.

sentences.zh: 詔吏人但犯贓罪，雖會赦，非待旨不敘。

translations.literal: An edict said that officials and clerks who committed embezzlement, even if an amnesty applied, were not to be restored to office without a special order.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ruled that officials and clerks guilty of embezzlement, even when an amnesty applied, could not resume office without a special order.

sentences.zh: 以勸農使蒲察莎魯窩等為賀宋生日使。

translations.literal: Agriculture-encouragement commissioner Pucha Shaluwo and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday.
translations.idiomatic: Agriculture-encouragement commissioner Pucha Shaluwo and others were sent as envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday.

sentences.zh: 辛未，參知政事唐括安禮罷。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Participation Councillor Tangguo Anli left office.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Participation Councillor Tangguo Anli left office.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以宿直將軍唐括鶻魯為夏國生日使。

translations.literal: On yihai, Night-Duty General Tangguo Helu was made Western Xia birthday envoy.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Night-Duty General Tangguo Helu was sent as Western Xia birthday envoy.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，地震。

translations.literal: On gengchen, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以都水監李衛國為高麗生日使。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Director of Waterworks Li Weiguo was made Goryeo birthday envoy.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Director of Waterworks Li Weiguo was sent as Goryeo birthday envoy.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，秋獵。

translations.literal: On yiyou, autumn hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he held the autumn hunt.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，次保州。

translations.literal: On gengyin, he halted at Baozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he made camp at Baozhou.

sentences.zh: 詔修起居注王天祺察訪所經過州縣官。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Recorder of Conduct Wang Tianqi to investigate the local officials of prefectures and counties he passed through.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Recorder of Conduct Wang Tianqi to investigate the officials of the prefectures and counties he passed through.

sentences.zh: 十月乙未朔，上謂侍臣曰：「近聞朕所幸郡邑，會宴寢堂宇，後皆避之，此甚無謂，可宣諭，令仍舊居止。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on yiwei, the new moon, the emperor told his attendants: “I have heard that in the prefectures and counties I visit, when I hold banquets in their halls and bedchambers, the hosts afterward all move away—this is quite pointless; proclaim that they may remain as before.”
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on yiwei, the new moon, the emperor told his attendants: “Wherever I stay, the hosts vacate their halls and bedchambers after my banquets—they need not; proclaim that they may remain as before.”

sentences.zh: 」戊申，還都。

translations.literal: ” On wushen, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: ” On wushen he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，上謂宰臣曰：「海陵不辨人才優劣，惟徇己欲，多所升擢。

translations.literal: On dingsi, the emperor told the chief ministers: “Hailing could not distinguish superior from inferior talent but indulged his own desires and promoted many wrongly.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the emperor told his chief ministers: “Hailing could not tell good talent from bad but indulged his own wishes and promoted many unfit men.

sentences.zh: 朕即位以來，以此為戒，止取實才用之。

translations.literal: Since my accession I have taken this as a warning and employ only those with real ability.”
translations.idiomatic: Since my accession I have kept this warning in mind and use only men of real ability.”

sentences.zh: 近聞蠡州同知移剌延壽在官汙濫，詢其出身，乃正隆時鷹房子。

translations.literal: Recently I heard that Lizhou vice prefect Yila Yanshou is corrupt in office; on inquiry his origins are as a hawk-yard boy of the Zhenglong era.
translations.idiomatic: Lately I heard that Lizhou vice prefect Yila Yanshou is corrupt in office; when I asked his background, he turned out to be a hawk-yard boy from the Zhenglong era.

sentences.zh: 如鷹房、廚人之類，可典城牧民耶？

translations.literal: Can men of hawk yards and kitchen staff govern cities and shepherd the people?
translations.idiomatic: Can hawk-yard boys and kitchen staff govern cities and care for the people?

sentences.zh: 自今如此局分，不得授以臨民職任。

translations.literal: From now on, such categories must not be given posts governing the people.”
translations.idiomatic: From now on, men of such backgrounds must not be given posts that govern the people.”

sentences.zh: 」以御史中丞孟浩為參知政事。

translations.literal: ” Censor-in-chief Meng Hao was made participation councillor.
translations.idiomatic: ” Censor-in-chief Meng Hao became participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 是日，參知政事耨碗溫敦兀帶薨。

translations.literal: That day, participation councillor Nuwendi Wentun Wudai died.
translations.idiomatic: That same day participation councillor Nuwendi Wentun Wudai died.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，敕有司于東宮涼樓前增建殿位，孟浩諫曰：「皇太子雖為儲貳，宜示以儉德，不當與至尊宮室相俟。

translations.literal: On xinyou, an edict charged the offices to add palace seats before the Eastern Palace cool hall. Meng Hao remonstrated: “Though the crown prince is heir apparent, he should be shown frugal virtue and ought not rival the sovereign’s palace quarters.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou an edict ordered the offices to add palace seats before the Eastern Palace cool hall. Meng Hao remonstrated: “The crown prince is heir apparent, but he should be shown frugal virtue and must not rival the sovereign’s quarters.

sentences.zh: 」乃罷之。

translations.literal: ” It was then cancelled.
translations.idiomatic: ” The project was then cancelled.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙丑朔，上謂宰臣曰：「聞縣令多非其人，其令吏部察其善惡，明加黜陟。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on yichou, the new moon, the emperor told the chief ministers: “I hear many county magistrates are not the right men; order the Ministry of Personnel to examine good and bad and clearly promote or demote.”
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yichou, the new moon, the emperor told the chief ministers: “I hear many county magistrates are unfit; have the Ministry of Personnel weigh their merit and fault and promote or demote them clearly.”

sentences.zh: 」辛未，以河間尹徒單克甯等為賀宋正旦使。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Hejian intendant Tushan Kening and others were made Song New Year envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Hejian intendant Tushan Kening and others were sent as Song New Year envoys.

sentences.zh: 壬申，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On renshen, Venus appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Venus was seen in daylight.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，歲星晝見。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Jupiter appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Jupiter was seen in daylight.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，樞密副使徒單合喜罷。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Deputy Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Tushan Hexi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Deputy Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Tushan Hexi left office.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊戌，東京留守徒單合喜、北京留守完顏謀衍、肇州防禦使蒲察通朝辭，賜通金帶，諭之曰：「卿雖有才，然用心多詐，朕左右須忠實人，故命卿補外。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on wuxu, Eastern Capital regent Tushan Hexi, Northern Capital regent Wanyan Moyan, and Zhaozhou defense commissioner Pucha Tong took leave; Tong was given a gold belt. The emperor instructed him: “You have talent, but your mind is much given to deceit; I need honest men at my side, so I have appointed you abroad.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuxu, Eastern Capital regent Tushan Hexi, Northern Capital regent Wanyan Moyan, and Zhaozhou defense commissioner Pucha Tong took leave; Tong was given a gold belt. The emperor told him: “You have ability, but your heart is full of guile; I need loyal men beside me, so I am sending you abroad.

sentences.zh: 賜卿金帶者，答卿服勞之久也！

translations.literal: I give you this gold belt in recompense for your long service!”
translations.idiomatic: I give you this gold belt to repay your long service!”

sentences.zh: 」又顧謂左宣徽使敬嗣暉曰：「如卿不可謂無才，所欠者純實耳！

translations.literal: ” He also turned to Left Imperial Household Commissioner Jing Sihui and said: “One cannot say you lack talent; what you lack is pure honesty!”
translations.idiomatic: ” He also turned to Left Imperial Household Commissioner Jing Sihui and said: “No one can say you lack talent; what you lack is plain honesty!”

sentences.zh: 」甲辰，以北京留守完顏思敬為平章政事。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Northern Capital regent Wanyan Sijing was made associate administration councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Northern Capital regent Wanyan Sijing became associate administration councillor.

sentences.zh: 是歲，斷死囚二十人。

translations.literal: That year, twenty persons were sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: That year twenty persons were put to death.

sentences.zh: 八年正月甲子朔，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Eighth year, first month, on jiazi, the new moon, Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, on jiazi, the first month’s new moon, Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent New Year envoys.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，上謂宰臣曰：「朕治天下，方與卿等共之，事有不可，各當面陳，以輔朕之不逮，慎毋阿順取容。

translations.literal: On yichou, the emperor told the chief ministers: “I govern the realm together with you; when anything is wrong, speak frankly to aid my shortcomings—do not flatter to please.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the emperor told the chief ministers: “I govern the realm together with you; when anything is amiss, speak to my face to remedy my faults—do not curry favor by flattery.

sentences.zh: 卿等致位公相，正行道揚名之時，苟或偷安自便，雖為今日之幸，後世以為何如？

translations.literal: You hold the highest offices; this is the time to walk the upright path and make a name; if you only seek ease for yourselves, though fortunate today, what will posterity say?”
translations.idiomatic: You stand at the summit of office; this is the time to walk the straight path and win a name; if you only seek your own ease, you may be lucky today, but what will posterity say of you?”

sentences.zh: 」群臣皆稱萬歲。

translations.literal: ” The ministers all shouted long life.
translations.idiomatic: ” The ministers all shouted “Long live the emperor!”

sentences.zh: 辛未，謂秘書監移剌子敬等曰：「昔唐、虞之時，未有華飾，漢惟孝文務為純儉。

translations.literal: On xinwei, he told Secretariat Director Yila Zijing and others: “In the time of Yao and Shun there was no lavish ornament; Han’s Emperor Wen devoted himself to pure frugality.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he told Secretariat Director Yila Zijing and others: “In the age of Yao and Shun there was no lavish display; Emperor Wen of Han strove for pure frugality.

sentences.zh: 朕於宮室惟恐過度，其或興修，即損宮人歲費以充之，今亦不復營建矣！

translations.literal: In palace building I fear only excess; if I must build, I deduct palace women’s annual allotment to pay for it—and now I build no more!”
translations.idiomatic: In palace building I fear only excess; when I must build, I cut palace women’s yearly stipends to pay for it—and now I build no more!”

sentences.zh: 如宴飲之事，近惟太子生日及歲元嘗飲酒，往者亦止上元、中秋飲之，亦未嘗至醉。

translations.literal: As for banquets, lately I drink only on the crown prince’s birthday and at New Year; formerly I drank only at Lantern Festival and Mid-Autumn, and never to drunkenness.
translations.idiomatic: As for feasting, lately I drink only on the crown prince’s birthday and at New Year; before, I drank only at Lantern Festival and Mid-Autumn, and never to drunkenness.

sentences.zh: 至於佛法，尤所未信。

translations.literal: As for the Buddhist Law, I trust it least of all.
translations.idiomatic: As for the Buddhist teaching, I trust it least of all.

sentences.zh: 梁武帝為同泰寺奴，遼道宗以民戶賜寺僧，複加以三公之官，其惑深矣！

translations.literal: Liang Wudi became a slave at Tongtai Temple; Liao Daozong gave common households to temple monks and even added the rank of Three Dukes—the delusion runs deep!”
translations.idiomatic: Liang Wudi made himself a slave at Tongtai Temple; Liao Daozong gave common households to temple monks and even added the Three Dukes rank—the delusion runs deep!”

sentences.zh: 」庚辰，行皇太子冊禮。

translations.literal: ” On gengchen, the crown prince investiture rites were performed.
translations.idiomatic: ” On gengchen the crown prince investiture rites were performed.

sentences.zh: 二月甲午朔，制子為改嫁母服喪三年。

translations.literal: Second month, on jiawu, the new moon, a rule was made that sons observe three years’ mourning for remarried mothers.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiawu, the new moon, a rule was made that sons observe three years’ mourning for a remarried mother.

sentences.zh: 上諭左宣徽使敬嗣暉曰：「凡為人臣，上欲要君之恩，下欲幹民之譽，必虧忠節，卿宜戒之！」

translations.literal: The emperor instructed Left Imperial Household Commissioner Jing Sihui: “Any minister who above seeks the ruler’s favor and below seeks popular praise must impair loyalty—take warning!”
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told Left Imperial Household Commissioner Jing Sihui: “Any minister who above courts the ruler’s favor and below courts the people’s praise must wound loyalty—be warned!”

sentences.zh: 三月癸亥朔，萬春節，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Third month, on guihai, the new moon, Ten-Thousand Springs festival; Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guihai, the new moon, the Ten-Thousand Springs festival; Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 己巳，命以職官子補令史。

translations.literal: On jisi, an order that sons of officials be appointed as clerks.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi an order was issued that sons of officials be appointed as clerks.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，命護衛親軍百戶、五十戶，非直日不得帶刀入宮，己丑，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On dingchou, an order that hundred-household and fifty-household heads of the Palace Guard escort, when not on daily duty, must not enter the palace bearing blades; on jichou, Venus appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou an order was issued that hundred-household and fifty-household heads of the Palace Guard, when not on daily guard, must not enter the palace with blades; on jichou Venus was seen in daylight.

sentences.zh: 四月丙午，詔曰：「馬者軍旅所用，牛者農耕之資，殺牛有禁，馬亦何殊，其令禁之。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on bingwu, an edict said: “Horses are for the army, cattle for farming; killing cattle is forbidden—how are horses different? Let it be forbidden.”
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on bingwu, an edict read: “Horses serve the armies and cattle serve the fields; killing cattle is forbidden—how are horses different? Let slaughter of horses be forbidden as well.”

sentences.zh: 」戊申，擊球常武殿，司天馬貴中諫曰：「陛下為天下主，系社稷之重，又春秋高，圍獵擊球危事也，宜悉罷之。

translations.literal: ” On wushen, cuju at Changwu Hall; Ma Guizhong of the Astronomical Bureau remonstrated: “Your Majesty is lord of the realm, bearing the weight of altars of soil and grain; your years are also advanced—hunting and cuju are perilous; best abolish them all.”
translations.idiomatic: ” On wushen he played cuju at Changwu Hall; Ma Guizhong of the Astronomical Bureau remonstrated: “Your Majesty is lord of all under Heaven and bears the altars of soil and grain; your years are also high—hunting and cuju are dangerous; abolish them entirely.”

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「朕以示習武耳！

translations.literal: The emperor said: “I do it only to show martial training!”
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: “I do it only to keep up martial practice!”

sentences.zh: 」五月甲子，北望澱大震、風、雨雹，廣十裏，長六十裏。

translations.literal: ” Fifth month, on jiazi, at Beiwang Marsh great earthquake, wind, rain, and hail—ten li wide, sixty li long.
translations.idiomatic: ” In the fifth month, on jiazi, at Beiwang Marsh came a great earthquake, wind, rain, and hail ten li across and sixty li long.

sentences.zh: 詔戶、工兩部，自今宮中之飾，並勿用黃金。

translations.literal: An edict to the Households and Works ministries: from now on no gold in palace ornaments.
translations.idiomatic: An edict to the Households and Works ministries ordered that palace ornaments use no gold from this time forward.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，上如涼陘。

translations.literal: On yichou, the emperor went to Liang Gorge.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he went to Liang Gorge.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，歲星晝見。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Jupiter appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Jupiter was seen in daylight.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，改旺國崖曰靜寧山，曷裏滸東川曰金蓮川。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Wangguo Cliff was renamed Jingning Mountain and Heli Ford East Stream Golden Lotus Stream.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Wangguo Cliff was renamed Jingning Mountain and Heli Ford East Stream Golden Lotus Stream.

sentences.zh: 六月，河決李固渡，水入曹州。

translations.literal: Sixth month, the Yellow River broke at Ligudu Ford and water entered Caozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the Yellow River burst at Ligudu Ford and water poured into Caozhou.

sentences.zh: 七月甲子，制盜群牧馬者死，告者給錢三百貫。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on jiazi, a rule: theft of herd horses is capital; informants receive three hundred strings cash.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on jiazi, a rule was made that theft of herd horses is capital and informants receive three hundred strings of cash.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，上謂平章政事完顏思敬等曰：「朕思得賢士，寤寐不忘。

translations.literal: On wuchen, the emperor told associate administration councillor Wanyan Sijing and others: “I desire worthy men and do not forget them waking or sleeping.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the emperor told associate administration councillor Wanyan Sijing and others: “I long for worthy men and do not forget them waking or sleeping.

sentences.zh: 自今朝臣出外，即令體訪外任職官廉能者，及草萊之士可以助治者，具姓名以聞。

translations.literal: Whenever court ministers go abroad from today, have them inquire on route about upright and able local officials and commoners in the wild who could aid governance, and report names.”
translations.idiomatic: From today, whenever court ministers travel abroad, have them inquire along the way for upright and able local officials and talented commoners who could aid governance, and report their names.”

sentences.zh: 」甲戌，秋獵。

translations.literal: ” On jiaxu, autumn hunt.
translations.idiomatic: ” On jiaxu, the autumn hunt.

sentences.zh: 己卯，次三叉口。

translations.literal: On jimao, halted at Sanjiao Ford.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he halted at Sanjiao Ford.

sentences.zh: 上諭點檢司曰：「沿路禾稼甚佳，其扈從人少有蹂踐，則當汝罪。」

translations.literal: The emperor instructed the Inspection Office: “The grain along the route is very fine; if any follower tramples it even slightly, you will be punished.”
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told the Inspection Office: “The crops along the route are excellent; if any follower tramples them even slightly, you will answer for it.”

sentences.zh: 八月乙卯，至自涼陘。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on yimao, returned from Liang Gorge.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yimao, he returned from Liang Gorge.

sentences.zh: 九月辛酉，上諭尚書右丞石琚、參政孟浩曰：「聞蔚州埰地蕈，役夫數百千人，朕所用幾何？

translations.literal: Ninth month, on xinyou, the emperor told Right Vice Director of the Secretariat Shi Ju and Participation Councillor Meng Hao: “I hear that at the mushroom grounds of Weizhou’s mining districts several hundred or a thousand corvée laborers are employed—how much do I myself use?
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinyou, the emperor told Right Vice Director Shi Ju and Participation Councillor Meng Hao: “I hear several hundred or a thousand corvée men work the mushroom grounds at Weizhou’s mining sites—how much of that is for me?

sentences.zh: 而擾動如此。

translations.literal: Yet the disturbance is on this scale.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the disruption is this great.

sentences.zh: 自今差役凡稱御前者，皆須稟奏，仍令附冊。

translations.literal: From now on, whenever corvée is labeled as for imperial use, it must be reported by memorial, and a register is still to be kept.”
translations.idiomatic: From now on any corvée called imperial must be memorialized to the throne, and a register kept.”

sentences.zh: 」癸亥，以右宣徽使移剌神獨斡等為賀宋生日使。

translations.literal: On guihai, Right Commissioner of the Palace Attendants’ Office Yelü Shenduwo and others were made birthday envoys to Song.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Right Commissioner of the Palace Attendants Yelü Shenduwo and others were sent as birthday envoys to Song.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以引進使高希甫為夏國生日使。

translations.literal: On jisi, Usher Commissioner Gao Xifu was made birthday envoy to Western Xia.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Usher Commissioner Gao Xifu was sent as birthday envoy to Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上幸東宮。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the emperor visited the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the emperor visited the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，上諭宰臣曰：「卿等舉用人材，凡己所知識，必使他人舉奏，朕甚不喜。

translations.literal: On guiyou, the emperor told the chief ministers: “When you recommend talent, if you already know someone you always have another person submit the memorial—I greatly dislike this.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he told the chief ministers: “When you recommend men, if you already know someone you always have another submit the memorial—I dislike that greatly.

sentences.zh: 如其果賢，何必以親疏為避忌也。

translations.literal: If he is truly worthy, why must you avoid him because of closeness or distance?”
translations.idiomatic: If he is truly able, why shrink from kinship or distance?”

sentences.zh: 」以戶部尚書魏子平為參知政事。

translations.literal: Minister of Revenue Wei Ziping was made participating grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Revenue Wei Ziping was appointed participating grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，上謂御史大夫李石曰：「台憲固在分別邪正，然內外百司豈謂無人？

translations.literal: On xinsi, the emperor told Censor-in-Chief Li Shi: “The censorate exists to distinguish the upright from the crooked—yet are the hundred offices inside and out without men?
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he told Censor-in-Chief Li Shi: “The censorate exists to separate right from wrong—yet do the hundred offices within and without lack worthy men?

sentences.zh: 惟見卿等劾人之罪，不聞舉善。

translations.literal: I see only that you impeach men’s faults and never hear you commend the good.
translations.idiomatic: I see only your impeachments and never hear you praise the good.

sentences.zh: 自今宜令監察御史分路刺舉善惡以聞。
